{"imo": 1012828, "beam": 14.8, "crew": 38, "hull": 1006, "mmsi": 319113600, "yard": "Koninklijke de Vries", "year": 2018, "about": "

The 97-metre Faith returned home to the Feadship Makkum yard in 2018 to be enhanced with a range of additional features and personalised touches based on changes in the owner’s plans. The biggest alteration involved a second wellness area on the bridge deck between the owners’ stateroom and guest suites on the main deck. Another interior refit item was to add an extra staff cabin. The owner also opted to give the exterior profile a more nautical look by replacing the white-painted window boxes on the main and bridge decks with a walnut-varnished variety, while larger wind-break doors were added to both aft decks.

Each Feadship client builds a bespoke superyacht based upon past experiences, current wishes and future plans. The same applies to every refit. Pure custom creation is by definition an ongoing process and the Feadship refit team has the flexibility required to accommodate every change in the owner’s thinking.

{"imo": 1012866, "beam": 14.1, "crew": 32, "hull": 695, "mmsi": 319107400, "yard": "Koninklijke de Vries", "year": 2016, "about": "

Aquarius was created for an expert in the world of hospitality. He poured all his experience in that domain into 92.00 metres of entertainment, relaxation and fun. Step onboard Graycliffs (ex-Moon Sand Too), a 33,50-metre Feadship. Graycliffs was conceived for an owner seeking a yacht with a maximum length of 34 metres, shallow draught and full Feadship pedigree. Built in aluminium and boasting a vertical bow and expansive wrap-around windows, her exterior is as purposeful as it is elegant. Inside, Bannenberg & Rowell Design have crafted a refined interior that accommodates up to eight guests across four staterooms, served by a crew of six. With a gross tonnage of 262 GT, Graycliffs delivers a remarkably spacious and tranquil onboard experience - defined by extreme silence and an absence of vibration that set her apart from anything else in this size range. Generous alfresco living areas span multiple decks - from sun loungers and dining on the upper terrace to a welcoming aft deck and swim platform.

• Interior design by Bannenberg & Rowell

• Generous VIP cabin on the lower deck that functions as a second master suite

Graycliffs was conceived for an owner seeking a yacht with a maximum length of 34 metres, shallow draught and full Feadship pedigree. Built in aluminium and boasting a vertical bow and expansive wrap-around windows, her exterior is as purposeful as it is elegant.

     

    Inside, Bannenberg & Rowell Design have crafted a refined interior that accommodates up to eight guests across four staterooms, served by a crew of six. With a gross tonnage of 262 GT, Graycliffs delivers a remarkably spacious and tranquil onboard experience - defined by extreme silence and an absence of vibration that set her apart from anything else in this size range. Generous alfresco living areas span multiple decks - from sun loungers and dining on the upper terrace to a welcoming aft deck and swim platform.

Step onboard Graycliffs (ex-Moon Sand Too), a 33,50-metre Feadship. Graycliffs was conceived for an owner seeking a yacht with a maximum length of 34 metres, shallow draught and full Feadship pedigree. Built in aluminium and boasting a vertical bow and expansive wrap-around windows, her exterior is as purposeful as it is elegant. Inside, Bannenberg & Rowell Design have crafted a refined interior that accommodates up to eight guests across four staterooms, served by a crew of six. With a gross tonnage of 262 GT, Graycliffs delivers a remarkably spacious and tranquil onboard experience - defined by extreme silence and an absence of vibration that set her apart from anything else in this size range. Generous alfresco living areas span multiple decks - from sun loungers and dining on the upper terrace to a welcoming aft deck and swim platform.

KEY FEATURES

• Rare opportunity to own a Feadship in this highly sought after size category

• Interior design by Bannenberg & Rowell

• Shallow draft of 1.8m, ideal for coastal cruising

• 2.5m ceiling height in main deck salon

• Generous VIP cabin on the lower deck that functions as a second master suite

Step onboard Graycliffs (ex-Moon Sand Too), a 33,50-metre Feadship. Graycliffs was conceived for an owner seeking a yacht with a maximum length of 34 metres, shallow draught and full Feadship pedigree. Built in aluminium and boasting a vertical bow and expansive wrap-around windows, her exterior is as purposeful as it is elegant. Inside, Bannenberg & Rowell Design have crafted a refined interior that accommodates up to eight guests across four staterooms, served by a crew of six. With a gross tonnage of 262 GT, Graycliffs delivers a remarkably spacious and tranquil onboard experience - defined by extreme silence and an absence of vibration that set her apart from anything else in this size range. Generous alfresco living areas span multiple decks - from sun loungers and dining on the upper terrace to a welcoming aft deck and swim platform.

KEY FEATURES

• Rare opportunity to own a Feadship in this highly sought after size category

• Interior design by Bannenberg & Rowell

• Shallow draft of 1.8m, ideal for coastal cruising

• 2.5m ceiling height in main deck salon

• Generous VIP cabin on the lower deck that functions as a second master suite

  15. COMMENTS

    Step onboard Graycliffs (ex-Moon Sand Too), a 33,50-metre Feadship. Graycliffs was conceived for an owner seeking a yacht with a maximum length of 34 metres, shallow draught and full Feadship pedigree. Built in aluminium and boasting a vertical bow and expansive wrap-around windows, her exterior is as purposeful as it is elegant.

     

    Inside, Bannenberg & Rowell Design have crafted a refined interior that accommodates up to eight guests across four staterooms, served by a crew of six. With a gross tonnage of 262 GT, Graycliffs delivers a remarkably spacious and tranquil onboard experience - defined by extreme silence and an absence of vibration that set her apart from anything else in this size range. Generous alfresco living areas span multiple decks - from sun loungers and dining on the upper terrace to a welcoming aft deck and swim platform.

     

    • KEY FEATURES

      • Rare opportunity to own a Feadship in this highly sought after size category
      • Interior design by Bannenberg & Rowell
      • Shallow draft of 1.8m, ideal for coastal cruising
      • 2.5m ceiling height in main deck salon
      • Generous VIP cabin on the lower deck that functions as a second master suite
      • Expansive upper terrace for relaxing and entertaining

The exterior styling of Vanish includes signature extra-thick teak cap rails that follow the contours of the bulwarks and look amazing both close-up and from afar. These spectacular oversized handrails have never been placed on a Feadship before yet seamlessly became an integral part of the design of Vanish. The stunning lines of the yacht both appear sleek and hint at her highly efficient hull design. Her silver hull and superstructure make her instantly recognizable in every port and anchorage.

The interior is an elegant blend of white marble, bleached oak, stainless, and Macassar ebony that creates a modern yet warm and welcoming environment. The large windows allowing plenty of natural light in the saloon and the cleverly designed rotating seating area allows guests to maximise the stunning views.

The exterior guest areas onboard are finished are perfect for both entertaining and relaxing. The aft deck is spacious with a magnificent bar extending from within the main salon. The sundeck is impressive and beautifully detailed and can be converted to be semi-enclosed and air-conditioned for comfortable use in all climates.

Como comprises two and a half decks – an exception for Feadship in the 21st century when most projects have four or five decks. She currently sails under the name Lady May.

She is one of the most outstanding yachts of her size ever built. Built by Feadship with naval architecture by Dubois and interior styling by RWD, she is a true leader in her class. The combination of this impressive team resulted in the yacht winning a succession of awards in 2015.

The stunning lines of the yacht both appear sleek and hint at her highly efficient hull design. Her silver hull and superstructure make her instantly recognizable in every port and anchorage.

The interior is an elegant blend of white marble, bleached oak, stainless, and Macassar ebony that creates a modern yet warm and welcoming environment. The large windows allowing plenty of natural light in the saloon and the cleverly designed rotating seating area allows guests to maximise the stunning views.

The exterior guest areas onboard are finished are perfect for both entertaining and relaxing. The aft deck is spacious with a magnificent bar extending from within the main salon. The sundeck is impressive and beautifully detailed and can be converted to be semi-enclosed and air-conditioned for comfortable use in all climates.

She is truly a unique and exemplary yacht from a renowned shipyard and embraces stylish design, finish and condition. She is ready for immediate use by a new owner.

  • KEY FEATURES

    • Feadship pedigree
    • Award winning design by Dubois and RWD
    • Extensive use of glass for panoramic views throughout the vessel
    • Magnificent bar extending from main salon onto aft deck
    • Expansive views in owner's suite on main deck
    • Partially enclosed and air conditioned sundeck
    • 10-year Lloyd's special survery completed 2024
    • Zero hour rebuild of generators, 2024
    • Main engines fully serviced, 2024

She is one of the most outstanding yachts of her size ever built. Built by Feadship with naval architecture by Dubois and interior styling by RWD, she is a true leader in her class. The combination of this impressive team resulted in the yacht winning a succession of awards in 2015.

The stunning lines of the yacht both appear sleek and hint at her highly efficient hull design. Her silver hull and superstructure make her instantly recognizable in every port and anchorage.

The interior is an elegant blend of white marble, bleached oak, stainless, and Macassar ebony that creates a modern yet warm and welcoming environment. The large windows allowing plenty of natural light in the saloon and the cleverly designed rotating seating area allows guests to maximise the stunning views.

The exterior guest areas onboard are finished are perfect for both entertaining and relaxing. The aft deck is spacious with a magnificent bar extending from within the main salon. The sundeck is impressive and beautifully detailed and can be converted to be semi-enclosed and air-conditioned for comfortable use in all climates.

She is truly a unique and exemplary yacht from a renowned shipyard and embraces stylish design, finish and condition. She is ready for immediate use by a new owner.

She is one of the most outstanding yachts of her size ever built. Built by Feadship with naval architecture by Dubois and interior styling by RWD, she is a true leader in her class. The combination of this impressive team resulted in the yacht winning a succession of awards in 2015.

The stunning lines of the yacht both appear sleek and hint at her highly efficient hull design. Her silver hull and superstructure make her instantly recognizable in every port and anchorage.

The interior is an elegant blend of white marble, bleached oak, stainless, and Macassar ebony that creates a modern yet warm and welcoming environment. The large windows allowing plenty of natural light in the saloon and the cleverly designed rotating seating area allows guests to maximise the stunning views.

The exterior guest areas onboard are finished are perfect for both entertaining and relaxing. The aft deck is spacious with a magnificent bar extending from within the main salon. The sundeck is impressive and beautifully detailed and can be converted to be semi-enclosed and air-conditioned for comfortable use in all climates.

She is truly a unique and exemplary yacht from a renowned shipyard and embraces stylish design, finish and condition. She is ready for immediate use by a new owner.

  • KEY FEATURES

    • Feadship pedigree
    • Award winning design by Dubois and RWD
    • Extensive use of glass for panoramic views throughout the vessel
    • Magnificent bar extending from main salon onto aft deck
    • Expansive views in owner's suite on main deck
    • Partially enclosed and air conditioned sundeck
    • 10-year Lloyd's special survery completed 2024
    • Zero hour rebuild of generators, 2024
    • Main engines fully serviced, 2024

She is one of the most outstanding yachts of her size ever built. Built by Feadship with naval architecture by Dubois and interior styling by RWD, she is a true leader in her class. The combination of this impressive team resulted in the yacht winning a succession of awards in 2015.

The stunning lines of the yacht both appear sleek and hint at her highly efficient hull design. Her silver hull and superstructure make her instantly recognizable in every port and anchorage.

The interior is an elegant blend of white marble, bleached oak, stainless, and Macassar ebony that creates a modern yet warm and welcoming environment. The large windows allowing plenty of natural light in the saloon and the cleverly designed rotating seating area allows guests to maximise the stunning views.

The exterior guest areas onboard are finished are perfect for both entertaining and relaxing. The aft deck is spacious with a magnificent bar extending from within the main salon. The sundeck is impressive and beautifully detailed and can be converted to be semi-enclosed and air-conditioned for comfortable use in all climates.

She is truly a unique and exemplary yacht from a renowned shipyard and embraces stylish design, finish and condition. She is ready for immediate use by a new owner.

Featuring a modern bow and whaleback sheer, the exterior design of the 46.22-metre semi-displacement motoryacht Como reflects the owner’s very specific ideas. The yacht has unprecedentedly large windows in the hull and there is a great deal of glass in the superstructure: the latter is placed on top of the metal rather than being set into it, creating a continuous glass surface. These glazed side panels give spectacular uninterrupted views from the owner’s stateroom. Como comprises two and a half decks – an exception for Feadship in the 21st century when most projects have four or five decks. She currently sails under the name Lady May.

She is one of the most outstanding yachts of her size ever built. Built by Feadship with naval architecture by Dubois and interior styling by RWD, she is a true leader in her class. The combination of this impressive team resulted in the yacht winning a succession of awards in 2015.

The stunning lines of the yacht both appear sleek and hint at her highly efficient hull design. Her silver hull and superstructure make her instantly recognizable in every port and anchorage.

The interior is an elegant blend of white marble, bleached oak, stainless, and Macassar ebony that creates a modern yet warm and welcoming environment. The large windows allowing plenty of natural light in the saloon and the cleverly designed rotating seating area allows guests to maximise the stunning views.

The exterior guest areas onboard are finished are perfect for both entertaining and relaxing. The aft deck is spacious with a magnificent bar extending from within the main salon. The sundeck is impressive and beautifully detailed and can be converted to be semi-enclosed and air-conditioned for comfortable use in all climates.

She is truly a unique and exemplary yacht from a renowned shipyard and embraces stylish design, finish and condition. She is ready for immediate use by a new owner.

  • KEY FEATURES

    • Feadship pedigree
    • Award winning design by Dubois and RWD
    • Extensive use of glass for panoramic views throughout the vessel
    • Magnificent bar extending from main salon onto aft deck
    • Expansive views in owner's suite on main deck
    • Partially enclosed and air conditioned sundeck
    • 10-year Lloyd's special survery completed 2024
    • Zero hour rebuild of generators, 2024
    • Main engines fully serviced, 2024

These glazed side panels give spectacular uninterrupted views from the owner’s stateroom. Como comprises two and a half decks – an exception for Feadship in the 21st century when most projects have four or five decks. She currently sails under the name Lady May.

Experience on-water living at its finest aboard the stunning yacht W. This exceptional vessel combines the renowned craftsmanship of Feadship with expansive deck spaces and a warm, inviting interior, ensuring an extraordinary experience for all guests. Recently undergoing an extensive 10-month refit at Feadship in 2020, W is in impeccable \"Like New\" condition, complete with impressive new amenities and a striking grey hull that commands attention.

 

W’s interior was masterfully designed by Bannenberg & Rowell, complemented by touches from A La Mer during her refit. The decor exudes chic modern elegance while creating a relaxing ambiance. Guests will be captivated by the meticulous use of fine Makassar wood flooring and Zebrano wall timbers among the stylish furnishings throughout the yacht. The bridge deck bar front is covered in bleached wenge, Makassar, and Sycamore marquetry with the salon tops in Arabescato (bright white). Both the main salon and bridge deck provide areas for socializing and relaxation, with the bridge deck featuring a versatile dining area that seamlessly invites the outdoors in, thanks to fully retractable doors for an alfresco dining experience.

 

Superyacht W comfortably accommodates up to 12 guests in five luxurious staterooms, plus 2 guests in a converted sleeping area. The main staircase is covered in Karelian birth, Makassar and sycamore marquetry. The main deck master stateroom serves as a private sanctuary, complete with its own balcony—ideal for savoring morning coffee or curling up with a good book. This expansive suite includes a lounge area, a generous walk-in closet with a dressing room, a king-size bed, and a lavish en-suite bath. The ensuite has Noir St Laurent (midnight black) and Calcatta (bright white) marble.

 

Below deck, two VIP staterooms offer king beds, while two convertible twin staterooms provide flexibility for guests. Additionally, a bridge deck converted sleeping area features a queen Murphy bed, accommodating two more guests with a full bath.

 

W boasts vast outdoor living areas, inviting guests to embrace the alfresco lifestyle. The sundeck serves as the heart of the yacht, perfect for basking in the sun. Enjoy multiple sunbathing spots, a large Jacuzzi, a shaded bar, and an outdoor dining area. Both bridge deck aft and main deck aft are equipped with comfortable lounging areas ideal for social gatherings.

 

Key Features

  • Extensive refit completed in 2020 at Feadship, Holland

  • Modern chic interior
  • Huge master suite complete with private balcony, lounge, and extensive dressing area

  • In 2023 the boat underwent its 10-year survey
  • All items per Lloyd’s protocol were inspected and signed off on

 

2020 Refit Summary

W underwent an 11-month refit in 2020 at Feadship, in the Netherlands. The primary renewal activities included placing a larger Jacuzzi on the sun deck and implementing major modifications to the interior layout. An inspired improvement to the main deck lounge has fashioned a far more open and uniform space, while the number of staterooms available has been increased from four to five plus a converted sleeping area on the bridge deck with a queen berth and full bath. The former VIP stateroom on the lower deck has been converted back to the original design of two equal-sized and equally luxurious guest suites to port and starboard. A double queen Murphy bed has been installed on the bridge deck lounge, and the adjacent powder room refitted into a dedicated marble-clad bathroom for those times when the lounge is used as a suite for guests, who will enjoy the best of views as well as lots of space.

 

The fine interior style developed by Bannenberg & Rowell Design in 2013 has been retained, complemented by various personal touches made by the owner, together with Fort Lauderdale-based A La Mer, Inc. On the technical front, the starting point was to ensure that all major systems on W were dialed back to ‘zero time'. The wheelhouse on W has been given a comprehensive upgrade with all-new screens. All onboard lighting has been switched from halogen to LEDs, which necessitated the removal of all ceilings and relaying of all cabling. The AV and IT systems have been totally renewed, and a new sewage treatment unit fitted. Both MTU main engines have been completely overhauled, and all other systems reviewed and modernized. Many other smaller maintenance jobs were also carried out, from sprucing up areas of the bridge colored by the sun to adding new glass inserts to all the interior cupboards.

 

This impressive refit involved close cooperation with the owner’s team and Feadship.

Experience on-water living at its finest aboard the stunning yacht W. This exceptional vessel combines the renowned craftsmanship of Feadship with expansive deck spaces and a warm, inviting interior, ensuring an extraordinary experience for all guests. Recently undergoing an extensive 10-month refit at Feadship in 2020, W is in impeccable \"Like New\" condition, complete with impressive new amenities and a striking grey hull that commands attention.

 

W’s interior was masterfully designed by Bannenberg & Rowell, complemented by touches from A La Mer during her refit. The decor exudes chic modern elegance while creating a relaxing ambiance. Guests will be captivated by the meticulous use of fine Makassar wood flooring and Zebrano wall timbers among the stylish furnishings throughout the yacht. The bridge deck bar front is covered in bleached wenge, Makassar, and Sycamore marquetry with the salon tops in Arabescato (bright white). Both the main salon and bridge deck provide areas for socializing and relaxation, with the bridge deck featuring a versatile dining area that seamlessly invites the outdoors in, thanks to fully retractable doors for an alfresco dining experience.

 

Superyacht W comfortably accommodates up to 12 guests in five luxurious staterooms, plus 2 guests in a converted sleeping area. The main staircase is covered in Karelian birth, Makassar and sycamore marquetry. The main deck master stateroom serves as a private sanctuary, complete with its own balcony—ideal for savoring morning coffee or curling up with a good book. This expansive suite includes a lounge area, a generous walk-in closet with a dressing room, a king-size bed, and a lavish en-suite bath. The ensuite has Noir St Laurent (midnight black) and Calcatta (bright white) marble.

 

Below deck, two VIP staterooms offer king beds, while two convertible twin staterooms provide flexibility for guests. Additionally, a bridge deck converted sleeping area features a queen Murphy bed, accommodating two more guests with a full bath.

 

W boasts vast outdoor living areas, inviting guests to embrace the alfresco lifestyle. The sundeck serves as the heart of the yacht, perfect for basking in the sun. Enjoy multiple sunbathing spots, a large Jacuzzi, a shaded bar, and an outdoor dining area. Both bridge deck aft and main deck aft are equipped with comfortable lounging areas ideal for social gatherings.

 

Key Features

  • Extensive refit completed in 2020 at Feadship, Holland
  • Offering the very latest in Feadship engineering and AV/IT technology
  • Modern chic interior
  • Huge master suite complete with private balcony, lounge, and extensive dressing area
  • Oversized sundeck with large hot tub
  • Quantum XT at rest stabilizers upgrade
  • Recent paint with stunning grey hull

10 Year Lloyds Survey

  • In 2023 the boat underwent its 10-year survey
  • All items per Lloyd’s protocol were inspected and signed off on

 

2020 Refit Summary

W underwent an 11-month refit in 2020 at Feadship, in the Netherlands. The primary renewal activities included placing a larger Jacuzzi on the sun deck and implementing major modifications to the interior layout. An inspired improvement to the main deck lounge has fashioned a far more open and uniform space, while the number of staterooms available has been increased from four to five plus a converted sleeping area on the bridge deck with a queen berth and full bath. The former VIP stateroom on the lower deck has been converted back to the original design of two equal-sized and equally luxurious guest suites to port and starboard. A double queen Murphy bed has been installed on the bridge deck lounge, and the adjacent powder room refitted into a dedicated marble-clad bathroom for those times when the lounge is used as a suite for guests, who will enjoy the best of views as well as lots of space.

 

The fine interior style developed by Bannenberg & Rowell Design in 2013 has been retained, complemented by various personal touches made by the owner, together with Fort Lauderdale-based A La Mer, Inc. On the technical front, the starting point was to ensure that all major systems on W were dialed back to ‘zero time'. The wheelhouse on W has been given a comprehensive upgrade with all-new screens. All onboard lighting has been switched from halogen to LEDs, which necessitated the removal of all ceilings and relaying of all cabling. The AV and IT systems have been totally renewed, and a new sewage treatment unit fitted. Both MTU main engines have been completely overhauled, and all other systems reviewed and modernized. Many other smaller maintenance jobs were also carried out, from sprucing up areas of the bridge colored by the sun to adding new glass inserts to all the interior cupboards.

 

This impressive refit involved close cooperation with the owner’s team and Feadship.

The foremost activities included placing a larger Jacuzzi on the sun deck and implementing major modifications to the interior layout. All on-board lighting was switched from halogen to LEDs, the AV/IT systems totally renewed and a new sewage treatment unit fitted. Experience on-water living at its finest aboard the stunning yacht W. This exceptional vessel combines the renowned craftsmanship of Feadship with expansive deck spaces and a warm, inviting interior, ensuring an extraordinary experience for all guests. Recently undergoing an extensive 10-month refit at Feadship in 2020, W is in impeccable \"Like New\" condition, complete with impressive new amenities and a striking grey hull that commands attention.

 

W’s interior was masterfully designed by Bannenberg & Rowell, complemented by touches from A La Mer during her refit. The decor exudes chic modern elegance while creating a relaxing ambiance. Guests will be captivated by the meticulous use of fine Makassar wood flooring and Zebrano wall timbers among the stylish furnishings throughout the yacht. The bridge deck bar front is covered in bleached wenge, Makassar, and Sycamore marquetry with the salon tops in Arabescato (bright white). Both the main salon and bridge deck provide areas for socializing and relaxation, with the bridge deck featuring a versatile dining area that seamlessly invites the outdoors in, thanks to fully retractable doors for an alfresco dining experience.

 

Superyacht W comfortably accommodates up to 12 guests in five luxurious staterooms, plus 2 guests in a converted sleeping area. The main staircase is covered in Karelian birth, Makassar and sycamore marquetry. The main deck master stateroom serves as a private sanctuary, complete with its own balcony—ideal for savoring morning coffee or curling up with a good book. This expansive suite includes a lounge area, a generous walk-in closet with a dressing room, a king-size bed, and a lavish en-suite bath. The ensuite has Noir St Laurent (midnight black) and Calcatta (bright white) marble.

 

Below deck, two VIP staterooms offer king beds, while two convertible twin staterooms provide flexibility for guests. Additionally, a bridge deck converted sleeping area features a queen Murphy bed, accommodating two more guests with a full bath.

 

W boasts vast outdoor living areas, inviting guests to embrace the alfresco lifestyle. The sundeck serves as the heart of the yacht, perfect for basking in the sun. Enjoy multiple sunbathing spots, a large Jacuzzi, a shaded bar, and an outdoor dining area. Both bridge deck aft and main deck aft are equipped with comfortable lounging areas ideal for social gatherings.

 

Key Features

  • Extensive refit completed in 2020 at Feadship, Holland
  • Offering the very latest in Feadship engineering and AV/IT technology
  • Modern chic interior
  • Huge master suite complete with private balcony, lounge, and extensive dressing area
  • Oversized sundeck with large hot tub
  • Quantum XT at rest stabilizers upgrade
  • Recent paint with stunning grey hull

2020 Refit Summary

W underwent an 11-month refit in 2020 at Feadship, in the Netherlands. The primary renewal activities included placing a larger Jacuzzi on the sun deck and implementing major modifications to the interior layout. An inspired improvement to the main deck lounge has fashioned a far more open and uniform space, while the number of staterooms available has been increased from four to five plus a converted sleeping area on the bridge deck with a queen berth and full bath. The former VIP stateroom on the lower deck has been converted back to the original design of two equal-sized and equally luxurious guest suites to port and starboard. A double queen Murphy bed has been installed on the bridge deck lounge, and the adjacent powder room refitted into a dedicated marble-clad bathroom for those times when the lounge is used as a suite for guests, who will enjoy the best of views as well as lots of space.

 

The fine interior style developed by Bannenberg & Rowell Design in 2013 has been retained, complemented by various personal touches made by the owner, together with Fort Lauderdale-based A La Mer, Inc. On the technical front, the starting point was to ensure that all major systems on W were dialed back to ‘zero time'. The wheelhouse on W has been given a comprehensive upgrade with all-new screens. All onboard lighting has been switched from halogen to LEDs, which necessitated the removal of all ceilings and relaying of all cabling. The AV and IT systems have been totally renewed, and a new sewage treatment unit fitted. Both MTU main engines have been completely overhauled, and all other systems reviewed and modernized. Many other smaller maintenance jobs were also carried out, from sprucing up areas of the bridge colored by the sun to adding new glass inserts to all the interior cupboards.

 

This impressive refit involved close cooperation with the owner’s team and Feadship.

  • Larger hot tub change
  • New exhaust risers

  • Addition of third generator by using emergency generator
  • Alarm monitoring and control system

Launched in 2013, the 57.60-metre Larisa features a contemporary classic exterior profile and strong curvaceous signature lines supported by a straight knuckle that runs all the way around the yacht from the bow to the stern. The liberal deployment of stainless-steel railings, particularly on the forward part of the yacht, descend into the top plate in a way that echoes the classic Feadships of old. Experience on-water living at its finest aboard the stunning yacht W. This exceptional vessel combines the renowned craftsmanship of Feadship with expansive deck spaces and a warm, inviting interior, ensuring an extraordinary experience for all guests. W’s interior was masterfully designed by Bannenberg & Rowell, complemented by touches from A La Mer during her refit. The decor exudes chic modern elegance while creating a relaxing ambiance. Guests will be captivated by the meticulous use of fine Makassar wood flooring and Zebrano wall timbers among the stylish furnishings throughout the yacht. The bridge deck bar front is covered in bleached wenge, Makassar, and Sycamore marquetry with the salon tops in Arabescato (bright white). The main staircase is covered in Karelian birth, Makassar and sycamore marquetry.   • In 2023 the boat underwent its 10-year survey
  • All items per Lloyd’s protocol were inspected and signed off on

 

2020 Refit Summary

W underwent an 11-month refit in 2020 at Feadship, in the Netherlands. The primary renewal activities included placing a larger Jacuzzi on the sun deck and implementing major modifications to the interior layout. An inspired improvement to the main deck lounge has fashioned a far more open and uniform space, while the number of staterooms available has been increased from four to five plus a converted sleeping area on the bridge deck with a queen berth and full bath. The former VIP stateroom on the lower deck has been converted back to the original design of two equal-sized and equally luxurious guest suites to port and starboard. A double queen Murphy bed has been installed on the bridge deck lounge, and the adjacent powder room refitted into a dedicated marble-clad bathroom for those times when the lounge is used as a suite for guests, who will enjoy the best of views as well as lots of space.

 

The fine interior style developed by Bannenberg & Rowell Design in 2013 has been retained, complemented by various personal touches made by the owner, together with Fort Lauderdale-based A La Mer, Inc. On the technical front, the starting point was to ensure that all major systems on W were dialed back to ‘zero time'. The wheelhouse on W has been given a comprehensive upgrade with all-new screens. All onboard lighting has been switched from halogen to LEDs, which necessitated the removal of all ceilings and relaying of all cabling. The AV and IT systems have been totally renewed, and a new sewage treatment unit fitted. Both MTU main engines have been completely overhauled, and all other systems reviewed and modernized. Many other smaller maintenance jobs were also carried out, from sprucing up areas of the bridge colored by the sun to adding new glass inserts to all the interior cupboards.

 

This impressive refit involved close cooperation with the owner’s team and Feadship.

  1. ACCOMMODATION
    • AFT DECK
      • TASIA'S covered After Deck is comfortably furnished with L-shaped settees and cocktail tables port and starboard, along with additional casual seating. The stair to the large aft boarding and swim platform is aft on centerline to access the dive lazarette and swim platform, where all watersports are launched.
    • MAIN SALON
      • Entry to the Main Salon is forward on centerline, via automatic sliding doors, opening to the full beam entertaining area aft, with oversize windows port and starboard for panoramic views of every port of call. The open arrangement, with couch, cocktail table and additional comfortable seating encourages relaxing interaction with the elegantly casual Deco - Caribbean motif and contrasting madrona burl and anigre, wood joinerwork.
    • DINING
      • The open Dining Salon adjoins forward, with an Oval dining table for twelve guests. Forward to starboard is the entry foyer which opens to the deck companionway, joins the main staircase to the skylounge and access to the galley and the Owner’s office and stateroom forward.
    • GALLEY
      • The Galley is on the port side of the main deck forward of the dinig area, with central island and large serving pantry adjoining the dining area which is perfect for seamless service. The galley features huge windows—a chef’s dream. A dumb waiter services the pantry in the sky lounge above, further facilitating ease of service.
    • MASTER SUITE
      • TASIA features a full beam Master suite forward on the main deck with King bed, extensive closet storage, owner’s desk, couch and chaise lounge, state of the art entertainment system and expansive windows port and starboard to further enhance the spaciousness of the stateroom. The ensuite Master Bathroom has a large steam shower, stunning Jacuzzi tub with skylight above, and breathtaking mural behind.
    • GUEST CABINS
      • Below deck are four guest staterooms with complimentary styling, clean lines and the elegant John Munford designed millwork seen throughout the yacht. There are two queen staterooms with ensuite bathrooms with Jacuzzi tub and shower. Two additional twin staterooms (each with a Pullman bunk) have ensuite bathrooms with showers complete with high finishes and luxurious marble work throughout. All staterooms have state of the art entertainment systems, individual A/C controls and safes for guest security.
    • BRIDGE DECK
      • Forward on the upper Bridge deck the Wheelhouse has recently completed an extensive redesign and upgrade. A unique and attractive feature of TASIA is the large tender storage bay aft of the wheelhouse on the port side, which keeps all the owners deck areas free of unsightly tenders. There is a crew pantry on the port side as well, serviced by the dumbwaiter, to facilitate the five star crew service. Aft is the popular Sky Lounge, the main entertaining space for guests to enjoy themselves with new couches & plenty of seating options. The wide, oversized windows on this deck offer guests bird’s eye views throughout their time onboard. A large screen TV and updated electronics including kaleidescape system provide guests with hours of entertainment.
      • The Bridge Deck Aft is the main al fresco dining location for TASIA, with a large oval table for seating up to 12 guests and comfortable aft seating arrangements. This area is completely covered keeping guests protected from sun and rain while eating or lounging. Additionally, there are wing doors on either side to protect this dining area from wind.
    • SUNDECK / FLYBRIDGE
      • The sundeck is the guest’s favorite area to lounge, sunbathe, and arrive into ports in style. The sundeck boasts an enclosed gym area, Jacuzzi and sunpads with ample seating for guests forward, and comfortable guest seating arrangements and a BBQ aft, perfect for the chef’s delights. 2024, all sundeck soft goods are new.
    • CAPTAIN & CREW
      • TASIA can accommodate up to 10 crew in 6 cabins, including a Captain’s cabin behind the wheelhouse and 5 additional crew cabins. Each crew cabin includes an ensuite bathroom. The crew mess is spacious and located aft of the crew cabins with adjacent laundry and walk in refrigerators and freezers. Below deck hides an extensive spare parts and dry storage area.

  1. COMMENT

TASIA’s Feadship Pedigree has been nurtured since her original launch, with all systems consistently serviced upgraded with an unwavering eye to preventative maintenance.

The design brilliance of John Munford coupled with the exterior styling flair of Guido de Groot and the unquestioned design, engineering and detailing expertise of the Feadship Devries yard, created this trend setting 499 GT Tri-deck Motor Yacht, which so elegantly bridges the gap between the most classic Feadships and the more modern, higher freeboard designs. In short, TASIA is simply stunning from all perspectives and she serves up four decks of luxurious comfort and entertainment, with a multitude of inviting outdoor living spaces for all to enjoy. Her Feadship Pedigree has been nurtured since her original launch, with all systems consistently serviced and upgraded with an eye to preventative maintenance.

TASIA has just completed a seven-month comprehensive structural, mechanical and cosmetic refit at Feadship’s Scheepsbouw in their Makkum, Netherlands drydock facility. SHe is in turn-key condition, including a new paint job from mast top to waterline utilizing state of the art premium Alexseal polyurethane with a gloss enhancer added. Feadship also completely renovated the underwater surface area with a complete sand blasting back to bare steel then faired, undercoated and finished with coats of new antifouling paint. Additionally, she has had a comprehensive mechanical and running gear refurbishing; shafts/seals/rudders/bearings, full stabiliser system and bow thruster rebuilds.

TASIA has completed her Lloyds 25-year classification renewal with a flawless classification survey. The list of refit improvements to her essential systems is impressive, totaling over €3,400,000. She is ready in every respect to cruise all oceans of the world in complete comfort, safety and indeed, luxury.

  1. ACCOMMODATION
    • AFT DECK
      • TASIA'S covered After Deck is comfortably furnished with L-shaped settees and cocktail tables port and starboard, along with additional casual seating. The stair to the large aft boarding and swim platform is aft on centerline to access the dive lazarette and swim platform, where all watersports are launched.
    • MAIN SALON
      • Entry to the Main Salon is forward on centerline, via automatic sliding doors, opening to the full beam entertaining area aft, with oversize windows port and starboard for panoramic views of every port of call. The open arrangement, with couch, cocktail table and additional comfortable seating encourages relaxing interaction with the elegantly casual Deco - Caribbean motif and contrasting madrona burl and anigre, wood joinerwork.
    • DINING
      • The open Dining Salon adjoins forward, with an Oval dining table for twelve guests. Forward to starboard is the entry foyer which opens to the deck companionway, joins the main staircase to the skylounge and access to the galley and the Owner’s office and stateroom forward.
    • GALLEY
      • The Galley is on the port side of the main deck forward of the dinig area, with central island and large serving pantry adjoining the dining area which is perfect for seamless service. The galley features huge windows—a chef’s dream. A dumb waiter services the pantry in the sky lounge above, further facilitating ease of service.
    • MASTER SUITE
      • TASIA features a full beam Master suite forward on the main deck with King bed, extensive closet storage, owner’s desk, couch and chaise lounge, state of the art entertainment system and expansive windows port and starboard to further enhance the spaciousness of the stateroom. The ensuite Master Bathroom has a large steam shower, stunning Jacuzzi tub with skylight above, and breathtaking mural behind.
    • GUEST CABINS
      • Below deck are four guest staterooms with complimentary styling, clean lines and the elegant John Munford designed millwork seen throughout the yacht. There are two queen staterooms with ensuite bathrooms with Jacuzzi tub and shower. Two additional twin staterooms (each with a Pullman bunk) have ensuite bathrooms with showers complete with high finishes and luxurious marble work throughout. All staterooms have state of the art entertainment systems, individual A/C controls and safes for guest security.
    • BRIDGE DECK
      • Forward on the upper Bridge deck the Wheelhouse has recently completed an extensive redesign and upgrade. A unique and attractive feature of TASIA is the large tender storage bay aft of the wheelhouse on the port side, which keeps all the owners deck areas free of unsightly tenders. There is a crew pantry on the port side as well, serviced by the dumbwaiter, to facilitate the five star crew service. Aft is the popular Sky Lounge, the main entertaining space for guests to enjoy themselves with new couches & plenty of seating options. The wide, oversized windows on this deck offer guests bird’s eye views throughout their time onboard. A large screen TV and updated electronics including kaleidescape system provide guests with hours of entertainment.
      • The Bridge Deck Aft is the main al fresco dining location for TASIA, with a large oval table for seating up to 12 guests and comfortable aft seating arrangements. This area is completely covered keeping guests protected from sun and rain while eating or lounging. Additionally, there are wing doors on either side to protect this dining area from wind.
    • SUNDECK / FLYBRIDGE
      • The sundeck is the guest’s favorite area to lounge, sunbathe, and arrive into ports in style. The sundeck boasts an enclosed gym area, Jacuzzi and sunpads with ample seating for guests forward, and comfortable guest seating arrangements and a BBQ aft, perfect for the chef’s delights. 2024, all sundeck soft goods are new.
    • CAPTAIN & CREW
      • TASIA can accommodate up to 10 crew in 6 cabins, including a Captain’s cabin behind the wheelhouse and 5 additional crew cabins. Each crew cabin includes an ensuite bathroom. The crew mess is spacious and located aft of the crew cabins with adjacent laundry and walk in refrigerators and freezers. Below deck hides an extensive spare parts and dry storage area.

The design brilliance of John Munford coupled with the exterior styling flair of Guido de Groot and the unquestioned design, engineering and detailing expertise of the Feadship Devries yard, created this trend setting 499 GT Tri-deck Motor Yacht, which so elegantly bridges the gap between the most classic Feadships and the more modern, higher freeboard designs. In short, TASIA is simply stunning from all perspectives and she serves up four decks of luxurious comfort and entertainment, with a multitude of inviting outdoor living spaces for all to enjoy. Her Feadship Pedigree has been nurtured since her original launch, with all systems consistently serviced and upgraded with an eye to preventative maintenance.

TASIA has just completed a seven-month comprehensive structural, mechanical and cosmetic refit at Feadship’s Scheepsbouw in their Makkum, Netherlands drydock facility. SHe is in turn-key condition, including a new paint job from mast top to waterline utilizing state of the art premium Alexseal polyurethane with a gloss enhancer added. Feadship also completely renovated the underwater surface area with a complete sand blasting back to bare steel then faired, undercoated and finished with coats of new antifouling paint. Additionally, she has had a comprehensive mechanical and running gear refurbishing; shafts/seals/rudders/bearings, full stabiliser system and bow thruster rebuilds.

TASIA has completed her Lloyds 25-year classification renewal with a flawless classification survey. The list of refit improvements to her essential systems is impressive, totaling over €3,400,000. She is ready in every respect to cruise all oceans of the world in complete comfort, safety and indeed, luxury.

Katrion is the representation of how a magnificent full displacement yacht of this stature can remain very much family-oriented. From the private breakfast room and the welcoming choice of fabrics in the lounges and the staterooms to the abundance of facilities for both leisure and relaxation, Katrion has an intimate and charming ‘down-home’ feel.   1. ACCOMMODATION
    • AFT DECK
      • TASIA'S covered After Deck is comfortably furnished with L-shaped settees and cocktail tables port and starboard, along with additional casual seating. The stair to the large aft boarding and swim platform is aft on centerline to access the dive lazarette and swim platform, where all watersports are launched.
    • MAIN SALON
      • Entry to the Main Salon is forward on centerline, via automatic sliding doors, opening to the full beam entertaining area aft, with oversize windows port and starboard for panoramic views of every port of call. The open arrangement, with couch, cocktail table and additional comfortable seating encourages relaxing interaction with the elegantly casual Deco - Caribbean motif and contrasting madrona burl and anigre, wood joinerwork.
    • DINING
      • The open Dining Salon adjoins forward, with an Oval dining table for twelve guests. Forward to starboard is the entry foyer which opens to the deck companionway, joins the main staircase to the skylounge and access to the galley and the Owner’s office and stateroom forward.
    • GALLEY
      • The Galley is on the port side of the main deck forward of the dinig area, with central island and large serving pantry adjoining the dining area which is perfect for seamless service. The galley features huge windows—a chef’s dream. A dumb waiter services the pantry in the sky lounge above, further facilitating ease of service.
    • MASTER SUITE
      • TASIA features a full beam Master suite forward on the main deck with King bed, extensive closet storage, owner’s desk, couch and chaise lounge, state of the art entertainment system and expansive windows port and starboard to further enhance the spaciousness of the stateroom. The ensuite Master Bathroom has a large steam shower, stunning Jacuzzi tub with skylight above, and breathtaking mural behind.
    • GUEST CABINS
      • Below deck are four guest staterooms with complimentary styling, clean lines and the elegant John Munford designed millwork seen throughout the yacht. There are two queen staterooms with ensuite bathrooms with Jacuzzi tub and shower. Two additional twin staterooms (each with a Pullman bunk) have ensuite bathrooms with showers complete with high finishes and luxurious marble work throughout. All staterooms have state of the art entertainment systems, individual A/C controls and safes for guest security.
    • BRIDGE DECK
      • Forward on the upper Bridge deck the Wheelhouse has recently completed an extensive redesign and upgrade. A unique and attractive feature of TASIA is the large tender storage bay aft of the wheelhouse on the port side, which keeps all the owners deck areas free of unsightly tenders. There is a crew pantry on the port side as well, serviced by the dumbwaiter, to facilitate the five star crew service. Aft is the popular Sky Lounge, the main entertaining space for guests to enjoy themselves with new couches & plenty of seating options. The wide, oversized windows on this deck offer guests bird’s eye views throughout their time onboard. A large screen TV and updated electronics including kaleidescape system provide guests with hours of entertainment.
      • The Bridge Deck Aft is the main al fresco dining location for TASIA, with a large oval table for seating up to 12 guests and comfortable aft seating arrangements. This area is completely covered keeping guests protected from sun and rain while eating or lounging. Additionally, there are wing doors on either side to protect this dining area from wind.
    • SUNDECK / FLYBRIDGE
      • The sundeck is the guest’s favorite area to lounge, sunbathe, and arrive into ports in style. The sundeck boasts an enclosed gym area, Jacuzzi and sunpads with ample seating for guests forward, and comfortable guest seating arrangements and a BBQ aft, perfect for the chef’s delights. 2024, all sundeck soft goods are new.
    • CAPTAIN & CREW
      • TASIA can accommodate up to 10 crew in 6 cabins, including a Captain’s cabin behind the wheelhouse and 5 additional crew cabins. Each crew cabin includes an ensuite bathroom. The crew mess is spacious and located aft of the crew cabins with adjacent laundry and walk in refrigerators and freezers. Below deck hides an extensive spare parts and dry storage area.

  1. COMMENT

TASIA’s Feadship Pedigree has been nurtured since her original launch, with all systems consistently serviced upgraded with an unwavering eye to preventative maintenance.

The design brilliance of John Munford coupled with the exterior styling flair of Guido de Groot and the unquestioned design, engineering and detailing expertise of the Feadship Devries yard, created this trend setting 499 GT Tri-deck Motor Yacht, which so elegantly bridges the gap between the most classic Feadships and the more modern, higher freeboard designs. In short, TASIA is simply stunning from all perspectives and she serves up four decks of luxurious comfort and entertainment, with a multitude of inviting outdoor living spaces for all to enjoy. Her Feadship Pedigree has been nurtured since her original launch, with all systems consistently serviced and upgraded with an eye to preventative maintenance.

TASIA has just completed a seven-month comprehensive structural, mechanical and cosmetic refit at Feadship’s Scheepsbouw in their Makkum, Netherlands drydock facility. SHe is in turn-key condition, including a new paint job from mast top to waterline utilizing state of the art premium Alexseal polyurethane with a gloss enhancer added. Feadship also completely renovated the underwater surface area with a complete sand blasting back to bare steel then faired, undercoated and finished with coats of new antifouling paint. Additionally, she has had a comprehensive mechanical and running gear refurbishing; shafts/seals/rudders/bearings, full stabiliser system and bow thruster rebuilds.

TASIA has completed her Lloyds 25-year classification renewal with a flawless classification survey. The list of refit improvements to her essential systems is impressive, totaling over €3,400,000. She is ready in every respect to cruise all oceans of the world in complete comfort, safety and indeed, luxury.

KEY FEATURES

  • Feadship pedigree
  • Excellent ownership and maintenance history
  • Only ever privately used
  • Full beam master on main deck
  • 10+2 guests in 5 cabins
  • Recently completed a multi-million Euro refit at Feadship including full repaint, engineering overhaul, 25-year Lloyds class survey

The stair to the large aft boarding and swim platform is aft on centerline to access the dive lazarette and swim platform, where all watersports are launched.
    • MAIN SALON
      • Entry to the Main Salon is forward on centerline, via automatic sliding doors, opening to the full beam entertaining area aft, with oversize windows port and starboard for panoramic views of every port of call. The open arrangement, with couch, cocktail table and additional comfortable seating encourages relaxing interaction with the elegantly casual Deco - Caribbean motif and contrasting madrona burl and anigre, wood joinerwork.
    • DINING
      • The open Dining Salon adjoins forward, with an Oval dining table for twelve guests. Forward to starboard is the entry foyer which opens to the deck companionway, joins the main staircase to the skylounge and access to the galley and the Owner’s office and stateroom forward.
    • GALLEY
      • The Galley is on the port side of the main deck forward of the dinig area, with central island and large serving pantry adjoining the dining area which is perfect for seamless service. The galley features huge windows—a chef’s dream. A dumb waiter services the pantry in the sky lounge above, further facilitating ease of service.
    • MASTER SUITE
      • TASIA features a full beam Master suite forward on the main deck with King bed, extensive closet storage, owner’s desk, couch and chaise lounge, state of the art entertainment system and expansive windows port and starboard to further enhance the spaciousness of the stateroom. The ensuite Master Bathroom has a large steam shower, stunning Jacuzzi tub with skylight above, and breathtaking mural behind.
    • GUEST CABINS
      • Below deck are four guest staterooms with complimentary styling, clean lines and the elegant John Munford designed millwork seen throughout the yacht. There are two queen staterooms with ensuite bathrooms with Jacuzzi tub and shower. Two additional twin staterooms (each with a Pullman bunk) have ensuite bathrooms with showers complete with high finishes and luxurious marble work throughout. All staterooms have state of the art entertainment systems, individual A/C controls and safes for guest security.
    • BRIDGE DECK
      • Forward on the upper Bridge deck the Wheelhouse has recently completed an extensive redesign and upgrade. A unique and attractive feature of TASIA is the large tender storage bay aft of the wheelhouse on the port side, which keeps all the owners deck areas free of unsightly tenders. There is a crew pantry on the port side as well, serviced by the dumbwaiter, to facilitate the five star crew service. Aft is the popular Sky Lounge, the main entertaining space for guests to enjoy themselves with new couches & plenty of seating options. The wide, oversized windows on this deck offer guests bird’s eye views throughout their time onboard. A large screen TV and updated electronics including kaleidescape system provide guests with hours of entertainment.
      • The Bridge Deck Aft is the main al fresco dining location for TASIA, with a large oval table for seating up to 12 guests and comfortable aft seating arrangements. This area is completely covered keeping guests protected from sun and rain while eating or lounging. Additionally, there are wing doors on either side to protect this dining area from wind.
    • SUNDECK / FLYBRIDGE
      • The sundeck is the guest’s favorite area to lounge, sunbathe, and arrive into ports in style. The sundeck boasts an enclosed gym area, Jacuzzi and sunpads with ample seating for guests forward, and comfortable guest seating arrangements and a BBQ aft, perfect for the chef’s delights. 2024, all sundeck soft goods are new.
    • CAPTAIN & CREW
      • TASIA can accommodate up to 10 crew in 6 cabins, including a Captain’s cabin behind the wheelhouse and 5 additional crew cabins. Each crew cabin includes an ensuite bathroom. The crew mess is spacious and located aft of the crew cabins with adjacent laundry and walk in refrigerators and freezers. Below deck hides an extensive spare parts and dry storage area.

  1. COMMENT

TASIA’s Feadship Pedigree has been nurtured since her original launch, with all systems consistently serviced upgraded with an unwavering eye to preventative maintenance.

The design brilliance of John Munford coupled with the exterior styling flair of Guido de Groot and the unquestioned design, engineering and detailing expertise of the Feadship Devries yard, created this trend setting 499 GT Tri-deck Motor Yacht, which so elegantly bridges the gap between the most classic Feadships and the more modern, higher freeboard designs. In short, TASIA is simply stunning from all perspectives and she serves up four decks of luxurious comfort and entertainment, with a multitude of inviting outdoor living spaces for all to enjoy. Her Feadship Pedigree has been nurtured since her original launch, with all systems consistently serviced and upgraded with an eye to preventative maintenance.

TASIA has just completed a seven-month comprehensive structural, mechanical and cosmetic refit at Feadship’s Scheepsbouw in their Makkum, Netherlands drydock facility. SHe is in turn-key condition, including a new paint job from mast top to waterline utilizing state of the art premium Alexseal polyurethane with a gloss enhancer added. Feadship also completely renovated the underwater surface area with a complete sand blasting back to bare steel then faired, undercoated and finished with coats of new antifouling paint. Additionally, she has had a comprehensive mechanical and running gear refurbishing; shafts/seals/rudders/bearings, full stabiliser system and bow thruster rebuilds.

TASIA has completed her Lloyds 25-year classification renewal with a flawless classification survey. The list of refit improvements to her essential systems is impressive, totaling over €3,400,000. She is ready in every respect to cruise all oceans of the world in complete comfort, safety and indeed, luxury.

Wedge Too offers accommodation for up to 18 guests in 9 cabins and 21 crew. 
The Owners deck situated above the main deck and below the wheelhouse deck, offers a full owner’s suite with two cabins, his and hers bathrooms and extensive walk-in wardrobes, a private lounge, pantry, guest powder room and elevator to all decks.  A fully private forward veranda and aft deck with full on deck walk around.

The Wheelhouse deck above has a spacious wheelhouse with office, a large ensuite captain’s cabin, a guest pantry, a guest powder room, and a spacious guest saloon with open aft deck and full walk around decks.
The sun deck is totally private, offering 360° uninterrupted view,  an oval pool surrounded by sunbathing pads for approx. 20 people in comfort.

The main deck forward boast’s three ensuite VIP cabins, one of which is full width. All are totally private with large windows in the ship’s side. The main dining room for 16 guests is full width with an adjacent pantry main galley and two guest powder rooms. Fully aft on this deck is the main guest saloon which offers spectacular views through full height windows throughout. The main deck aft is spacious and offers direct access down to the swimming platform.

The lower deck offers another 4 ensuite guest cabins, a large tender garage, aft peak with guest powder room and direct access to the large swimming platform.

Forward of the mid ships engine room are the crew cabins, spacious crew mess and crew galley. 
The tank deck offers a large laundry, dry stores, cool rom and freezer room.

The tank deck offers a large laundry, dry stores, cool rom and freezer room.

Her exterior has an art deco flavour, generated by the geometry of the shapes, the cleanliness of the detailing and the oiled teak deckhouse sides. Wedge Too is a yacht packed with the most intricate surprises with an incredible range of exquisite and bizarre features, including wheelbarrow chairs and garden gnomes.

The Owners deck situated above the main deck and below the wheelhouse deck, offers a full owner’s suite with two cabins, his and hers bathrooms and extensive walk-in wardrobes, a private lounge, pantry, guest powder room and elevator to all decks.  A fully private forward veranda and aft deck with full on deck walk around.

The Wheelhouse deck above has a spacious wheelhouse with office, a large ensuite captain’s cabin, a guest pantry, a guest powder room, and a spacious guest saloon with open aft deck and full walk around decks.
The sun deck is totally private, offering 360° uninterrupted view,  an oval pool surrounded by sunbathing pads for approx. 20 people in comfort.

The main deck forward boast’s three ensuite VIP cabins, one of which is full width. All are totally private with large windows in the ship’s side. The main dining room for 16 guests is full width with an adjacent pantry main galley and two guest powder rooms. Fully aft on this deck is the main guest saloon which offers spectacular views through full height windows throughout. The main deck aft is spacious and offers direct access down to the swimming platform.

The lower deck offers another 4 ensuite guest cabins, a large tender garage, aft peak with guest powder room and direct access to the large swimming platform.

Forward of the mid ships engine room are the crew cabins, spacious crew mess and crew galley. 
The tank deck offers a large laundry, dry stores, cool rom and freezer room.

Wedge Too offers accommodation for up to 18 guests in 9 cabins and 21 crew. 
The Owners deck situated above the main deck and below the wheelhouse deck, offers a full owner’s suite with two cabins, his and hers bathrooms and extensive walk-in wardrobes, a private lounge, pantry, guest powder room and elevator to all decks.  A fully private forward veranda and aft deck with full on deck walk around.

The Wheelhouse deck above has a spacious wheelhouse with office, a large ensuite captain’s cabin, a guest pantry, a guest powder room, and a spacious guest saloon with open aft deck and full walk around decks.
The sun deck is totally private, offering 360° uninterrupted view,  an oval pool surrounded by sunbathing pads for approx. 20 people in comfort.

The main deck forward boast’s three ensuite VIP cabins, one of which is full width. All are totally private with large windows in the ship’s side. The main dining room for 16 guests is full width with an adjacent pantry main galley and two guest powder rooms. Fully aft on this deck is the main guest saloon which offers spectacular views through full height windows throughout. The main deck aft is spacious and offers direct access down to the swimming platform.

The lower deck offers another 4 ensuite guest cabins, a large tender garage, aft peak with guest powder room and direct access to the large swimming platform.

Forward of the mid ships engine room are the crew cabins, spacious crew mess and crew galley. 
The tank deck offers a large laundry, dry stores, cool rom and freezer room.

Wedge Too offers accommodation for up to 18 guests in 9 cabins and 21 crew. 
The Owners deck situated above the main deck and below the wheelhouse deck, offers a full owner’s suite with two cabins, his and hers bathrooms and extensive walk-in wardrobes, a private lounge, pantry, guest powder room and elevator to all decks.  A fully private forward veranda and aft deck with full on deck walk around.

The Wheelhouse deck above has a spacious wheelhouse with office, a large ensuite captain’s cabin, a guest pantry, a guest powder room, and a spacious guest saloon with open aft deck and full walk around decks.
The sun deck is totally private, offering 360° uninterrupted view,  an oval pool surrounded by sunbathing pads for approx. 20 people in comfort.

The main deck forward boast’s three ensuite VIP cabins, one of which is full width. All are totally private with large windows in the ship’s side. The main dining room for 16 guests is full width with an adjacent pantry main galley and two guest powder rooms. Fully aft on this deck is the main guest saloon which offers spectacular views through full height windows throughout. The main deck aft is spacious and offers direct access down to the swimming platform.

The lower deck offers another 4 ensuite guest cabins, a large tender garage, aft peak with guest powder room and direct access to the large swimming platform.

Forward of the mid ships engine room are the crew cabins, spacious crew mess and crew galley. 
The tank deck offers a large laundry, dry stores, cool rom and freezer room.

Wedge Too offers accommodation for up to 18 guests in 9 cabins and 21 crew. 
The Owners deck situated above the main deck and below the wheelhouse deck, offers a full owner’s suite with two cabins, his and hers bathrooms and extensive walk-in wardrobes, a private lounge, pantry, guest powder room and elevator to all decks.  A fully private forward veranda and aft deck with full on deck walk around.

The Wheelhouse deck above has a spacious wheelhouse with office, a large ensuite captain’s cabin, a guest pantry, a guest powder room, and a spacious guest saloon with open aft deck and full walk around decks.
The sun deck is totally private, offering 360° uninterrupted view,  an oval pool surrounded by sunbathing pads for approx. 20 people in comfort.

The main deck forward boast’s three ensuite VIP cabins, one of which is full width. All are totally private with large windows in the ship’s side. The main dining room for 16 guests is full width with an adjacent pantry main galley and two guest powder rooms. Fully aft on this deck is the main guest saloon which offers spectacular views through full height windows throughout. The main deck aft is spacious and offers direct access down to the swimming platform.

The lower deck offers another 4 ensuite guest cabins, a large tender garage, aft peak with guest powder room and direct access to the large swimming platform.

Forward of the mid ships engine room are the crew cabins, spacious crew mess and crew galley. 
The tank deck offers a large laundry, dry stores, cool rom and freezer room.

Wedge Too offers accommodation for up to 18 guests in 9 cabins and 21 crew. 
The Owners deck situated above the main deck and below the wheelhouse deck, offers a full owner’s suite with two cabins, his and hers bathrooms and extensive walk-in wardrobes, a private lounge, pantry, guest powder room and elevator to all decks.  A fully private forward veranda and aft deck with full on deck walk around.

The Wheelhouse deck above has a spacious wheelhouse with office, a large ensuite captain’s cabin, a guest pantry, a guest powder room, and a spacious guest saloon with open aft deck and full walk around decks.
The sun deck is totally private, offering 360° uninterrupted view,  an oval pool surrounded by sunbathing pads for approx. 20 people in comfort.

The main deck forward boast’s three ensuite VIP cabins, one of which is full width. All are totally private with large windows in the ship’s side. The main dining room for 16 guests is full width with an adjacent pantry main galley and two guest powder rooms. Fully aft on this deck is the main guest saloon which offers spectacular views through full height windows throughout. The main deck aft is spacious and offers direct access down to the swimming platform.

The lower deck offers another 4 ensuite guest cabins, a large tender garage, aft peak with guest powder room and direct access to the large swimming platform.

Forward of the mid ships engine room are the crew cabins, spacious crew mess and crew galley. 
The tank deck offers a large laundry, dry stores, cool rom and freezer room.

Wedge Too offers accommodation for up to 18 guests in 9 cabins and 21 crew. 
The Owners deck situated above the main deck and below the wheelhouse deck, offers a full owner’s suite with two cabins, his and hers bathrooms and extensive walk-in wardrobes, a private lounge, pantry, guest powder room and elevator to all decks.  A fully private forward veranda and aft deck with full on deck walk around.

The Wheelhouse deck above has a spacious wheelhouse with office, a large ensuite captain’s cabin, a guest pantry, a guest powder room, and a spacious guest saloon with open aft deck and full walk around decks.
The sun deck is totally private, offering 360° uninterrupted view,  an oval pool surrounded by sunbathing pads for approx. 20 people in comfort.

The main deck forward boast’s three ensuite VIP cabins, one of which is full width. All are totally private with large windows in the ship’s side. The main dining room for 16 guests is full width with an adjacent pantry main galley and two guest powder rooms. Fully aft on this deck is the main guest saloon which offers spectacular views through full height windows throughout. The main deck aft is spacious and offers direct access down to the swimming platform.

The lower deck offers another 4 ensuite guest cabins, a large tender garage, aft peak with guest powder room and direct access to the large swimming platform.

Forward of the mid ships engine room are the crew cabins, spacious crew mess and crew galley. 
The tank deck offers a large laundry, dry stores, cool rom and freezer room.

The record of being the longest Feadship – since 1978 held by the 64.64-metre Al Riyadh – was broken with the launch of the 65.00-metre Wedge Too. With the legendary French designer Philippe Starck embarking on his first superyacht project, both the exterior styling and the interior design of Wedge Too are spectacular departures from the norm. Her exterior has an art deco flavour, generated by the geometry of the shapes, the cleanliness of the detailing and the oiled teak deckhouse sides. Wedge Too is a yacht packed with the most intricate surprises with an incredible range of exquisite and bizarre features, including wheelbarrow chairs and garden gnomes.

{"imo": 1007067, "beam": 9, "crew": null, "hull": 787, "mmsi": 229908000, "yard": "Royal van Lent", "year": 2017, "about": "

The 40-metre Cipitouba, launched as Seaflower in 2002, was returned to peak condition during a refit at the Feadship Makkum yard over the winter of 2016-2017. This extensive project involved fitting Caterpillar 100 ekW C7.1 generators with a SootTech exhaust gas filtration unit by Hug-Nauticlean, for which a hole was cut in the aft bulkhead in the beach club to access the diesel generator room. A new electrical power management system was also installed with new switchboards and alarm & monitoring system, while the main engines were overhauled and reset to zero hours. Cipitouba's interior was given a comprehensive makeover in close consultation with the owners. This included a new main deck salon & dining room and bridge deck lounge plus an upgrade to the master stateroom and guest suites. The hardware throughout the interior was renewed, new marble was placed in the guest bathrooms and an impressive new AV/IT and CCTV system installed.

MYSTIQUE is the ultimate luxury family yacht with the sought-after Feadship pedigree offering accommodation for 10-12 guests in 5 ensuite cabins. Her 6ft shallow draft offers exciting exploration in the turquoise waters of the Bahamas. MYSTIQUE's welcoming interior features distinctive high gloss, honeycomb Sycamore paneling accented with darker burlwood cabinetry and custom woven leather and fabric accents.

There is, unquestionably, no finer or more distinctive high-speed luxury motor yacht available on the market today. This multi-award-winning Feadship is truly one of a kind and perfect for the owner who wishes for an ultra-pedigree yacht with the option of an extraordinary turn of speed as well as the ability to cruise the Bahamas, the Keys, and other beautiful shallow-draft regions of the globe in luxurious comfort. 

This is a very special impeccably maintained yacht, with a light and modern interior design by the highly acclaimed John Munford and built by one of the most respected and renowned shipyards in the world.

Construction

Aluminum hull, aluminum superstructure, teak decks. This Feadship was designed and built to be a high-speed, shallow-draft yacht of the highest quality and pedigree. Built by a famous entrepreneur as \"Detroit Eagle\" to his exacting design and specifications, upon completion she was awarded \"The Best Power Yacht 43m+\" at The International Superyacht Society Awards (2002). 

Key Features

  • Impeccable maintenance, renewal and refit history by the dedicated, serial yacht Owners who have proudly called her their own
  • 25 Year Survey by American Bureau of Shipping completed in May 2025. 
  • USA Flagged and Duty Paid 
  • 12,900 total horsepower produced by 2 MTU 16V4000 M90 diesel engines and a Vericor TF-50 Lycoming gas turbine, producing a top speed of 35 knots
  • Shallow 6 foot draft - perfect for Bahamas cruising 
  • 2 full beam cabins: the Owner’s Suite King on Main Deck forward & the VIP Queen below 
  • 2 twin cabins, each with Pullman beds adjacent to the VIP lobby 
  • The Captain's Cabin aft of the Skylounge serves as an optional 5th Guest Cabin
  • The Cockpit serves as an additional exterior deck featuring a hydraulically operated, opening center stern section providing a custom swim platform / passerelle 
  • The Fly Bridge features a raised jacuzzi with sun pads, a service area, and 5 Captain’s chairs sharing the view at the Pilot’s station 
  • Starlink Maritime satellite system provides bandwidth for uninterrupted streaming & IT Connectivity via the state-of-the-art Wi-Fi network
  • A/V network - extensive movies, music & TV collection. Apple TV & DirecTV USA (HD dual antennas) & DirecTV streaming, iPad accessibility throughout

MYSTIQUE is the ultimate luxury family yacht with the sought-after Feadship pedigree offering accommodation for 10-12 guests in 5 ensuite cabins. Her 6ft shallow draft offers exciting exploration in the turquoise waters of the Bahamas. MYSTIQUE's welcoming interior features distinctive high gloss, honeycomb Sycamore paneling accented with darker burlwood cabinetry and custom woven leather and fabric accents.

There is, unquestionably, no finer or more distinctive high-speed luxury motor yacht available on the market today. This multi-award-winning Feadship is truly one of a kind and perfect for the owner who wishes for an ultra-pedigree yacht with the option of an extraordinary turn of speed as well as the ability to cruise the Bahamas, the Keys, and other beautiful shallow-draft regions of the globe in luxurious comfort. 

This is a very special impeccably maintained yacht, with a light and modern interior design by the highly acclaimed John Munford and built by one of the most respected and renowned shipyards in the world.

Construction

Aluminum hull, aluminum superstructure, teak decks. This Feadship was designed and built to be a high-speed, shallow-draft yacht of the highest quality and pedigree. Built by a famous entrepreneur as \"Detroit Eagle\" to his exacting design and specifications, upon completion she was awarded \"The Best Power Yacht 43m+\" at The International Superyacht Society Awards (2002). 

Key Features

  • Impeccable maintenance, renewal and refit history by the dedicated, serial yacht Owners who have proudly called her their own
  • 25 Year Survey by American Bureau of Shipping completed in May 2025. 
  • USA Flagged and Duty Paid 
  • 12,900 total horsepower produced by 2 MTU 16V4000 M90 diesel engines and a Vericor TF-50 Lycoming gas turbine, producing a top speed of 35 knots
  • Shallow 6 foot draft - perfect for Bahamas cruising 
  • 2 full beam cabins: the Owner’s Suite King on Main Deck forward & the VIP Queen below 
  • 2 twin cabins, each with Pullman beds adjacent to the VIP lobby 
  • The Captain's Cabin aft of the Skylounge serves as an optional 5th Guest Cabin
  • The Cockpit serves as an additional exterior deck featuring a hydraulically operated, opening center stern section providing a custom swim platform / passerelle 
  • The Fly Bridge features a raised jacuzzi with sun pads, a service area, and 5 Captain’s chairs sharing the view at the Pilot’s station 
  • Starlink Maritime satellite system provides bandwidth for uninterrupted streaming & IT Connectivity via the state-of-the-art Wi-Fi network
  • A/V network - extensive movies, music & TV collection. Apple TV & DirecTV USA (HD dual antennas) & DirecTV streaming, iPad accessibility throughout
