"}, "Sections": [{"Deleted": false, "VesselID": 450995, "CultureID": 1, "SectionID": 12318311, "SortOrder": 1, "SectionName": "OVERVIEW & KEY FEATURES ", "SectionText": "

MYSTIQUE is the ultimate luxury family yacht with the sought-after Feadship pedigree offering accommodation for 10-12 guests in 5 ensuite cabins. Her 6ft shallow draft offers exciting exploration in the turquoise waters of the Bahamas. MYSTIQUE's welcoming interior features distinctive high gloss, honeycomb Sycamore paneling accented with darker burlwood cabinetry and custom woven leather and fabric accents.

There is, unquestionably, no finer or more distinctive high-speed luxury motor yacht available on the market today. This multi-award-winning Feadship is truly one of a kind and perfect for the owner who wishes for an ultra-pedigree yacht with the option of an extraordinary turn of speed as well as the ability to cruise the Bahamas, the Keys, and other beautiful shallow-draft regions of the globe in luxurious comfort. 

This is a very special impeccably maintained yacht, with a light and modern interior design by the highly acclaimed John Munford and built by one of the most respected and renowned shipyards in the world.

Construction

Aluminum hull, aluminum superstructure, teak decks. This Feadship was designed and built to be a high-speed, shallow-draft yacht of the highest quality and pedigree. Built by a famous entrepreneur as \"Detroit Eagle\" to his exacting design and specifications, upon completion she was awarded \"The Best Power Yacht 43m+\" at The International Superyacht Society Awards (2002). 

Key Features

  • Impeccable maintenance, renewal and refit history by the dedicated, serial yacht Owners who have proudly called her their own
  • 25 Year Survey by American Bureau of Shipping completed in May 2025. 
  • USA Flagged and Duty Paid 
  • 12,900 total horsepower produced by 2 MTU 16V4000 M90 diesel engines and a Vericor TF-50 Lycoming gas turbine, producing a top speed of 35 knots
  • Shallow 6 foot draft - perfect for Bahamas cruising 
  • 2 full beam cabins: the Owner’s Suite King on Main Deck forward & the VIP Queen below 
  • 2 twin cabins, each with Pullman beds adjacent to the VIP lobby 
  • The Captain's Cabin aft of the Skylounge serves as an optional 5th Guest Cabin
  • The Cockpit serves as an additional exterior deck featuring a hydraulically operated, opening center stern section providing a custom swim platform / passerelle 
  • The Fly Bridge features a raised jacuzzi with sun pads, a service area, and 5 Captain’s chairs sharing the view at the Pilot’s station 
  • Starlink Maritime satellite system provides bandwidth for uninterrupted streaming & IT Connectivity via the state-of-the-art Wi-Fi network
  • A/V network - extensive movies, music & TV collection. Apple TV & DirecTV USA (HD dual antennas) & DirecTV streaming, iPad accessibility throughout

{"Beam": 31, "City": "", "Open": false, "Year": 2000, "tags": [], "MLSID": 408819, "Model": "50m Motoryacht", "Length": 165, "Sleeps": 12, "EventID": 0, "IsModel": false, "LOAFeet": 165, "details": {"VD": {"VesselID": 408819, "CultureID": 1, "DataSource": 1, "VesselName": "REVERIE", "CultureName": "English", "CultureShortName": "EN", "Loading_ShortDescription": false, "Loading_MyWebSiteDescription": false, "VesselDescriptionBrokerTeaser": "REVERIE emerges with a flawless new paint job (2025), along with a list of other upgrades, including her 5-year class survey.", "Loading_YatcoDotComDescription": false, "VesselDescriptionInternalTeaser": "REVERIE emerges with a flawless new paint job (2025), along with a list of other upgrades, including her 5-year class survey.", "VesselDescriptionShortDescription": "

REVERIE is a magnificent 165’ (50m) superyacht crafted to perfection by the renowned Feadship shipyard. She was delivered in 2000, fully refitted in 2017 with a new interior, and received several major upgrades in the past two years, ensuring she remains at the forefront of modern luxury while retaining her classic charm. The décor and styling of both the exterior and interior, designed by award-winning stylists, exudes sophistication and comfort. REVERIE offers accommodations for up to 12 guests in six comfortable staterooms, each with a private ensuite.

Starting from the aft deck, you will step onto a spacious haven for relaxation, equipped with comfortable seating, advanced entertainment features, and a full wet bar. Just steps away is the extended swim platform is perfect for an abundance of aquatic activities. As you enter REVERIE’s main salon you are greeted by an expansive, open concept living space. The lavish interior sports chic furnishings and custom finishes throughout the sprawling open layout. Nearby, the dining area features space for up to ten at the dining table, and a custom-built extensive wine cooler. Adjacent to the dining space, a sleek, fully equipped galley is hidden behind a partition, allowing the crew to prepare delicious meals without disturbing the guests.

Continuing forward on the main deck, the full beam owner’s stateroom is a sanctuary of comfort and style. It includes a king bed, seating area, private study, and large marble ensuite featuring his-and-hers sinks with gold bathroom fixtures and a plunge tub. Adjacent to the owner’s suite is the VIP stateroom, with a walk-around queen bed and private ensuite.

Descending the central staircase to the lower deck you will find the additional four staterooms, each with king-size beds and luxurious bedding, top-tier entertainment systems, and unique decor. Two of the suites are convertible to twin staterooms to suit any guests needs. Central to these staterooms you will find a convenient pantry, offering an array of refreshments. Also on the lower deck are the crew quarters, room for 12 and privately situated as to not disturb guests.

Retreat up to the sky lounge for an oasis of sophistication complimented by stunning panoramic ocean views while relaxing on the crescent-shaped sofa or sitting at the games table. Out on the upper aft deck, experience a spacious area perfect for lounging and dining al fresco. A large dining table makes this an ideal spot for any occasion, from causal gatherings to elegant events. Or spend some time on the forward bridge deck in a quiet space with cozy seating. Nearby, on the starboard side deck, a shaded gym and spa make this spot a great place for peace, privacy, and relaxation.

Atop Reverie, the sundeck is the epitome of luxury. It features lavish seating, casual outdoor dining, a stylish wet bar, and sun pads encircling a magnificent Jacuzzi. Whether it’s enjoying a cocktail at sunset or a late-night dip in the Jacuzzi, the sun deck is designed for ultimate relaxation and unparalleled ocean views.

From the spacious living areas and the sprawling decks to being equipped with state-of-the-art technology and engineering, REVERIE is a seamless blend of luxury and efficiency. Expansive deck space is plentiful on all three levels, providing several functional places for both entertainment and relaxation. REVERIE’s accommodations are designed to provide an intimate and serene retreat for every guest.

*Not for sale to US residents while in US waters.*

REVERIE is a magnificent 165’ (50m) superyacht crafted to perfection by the renowned Feadship shipyard. She was delivered in 2000, fully refitted in 2017 with a new interior, and received several major upgrades in the past two years, ensuring she remains at the forefront of modern luxury while retaining her classic charm. The décor and styling of both the exterior and interior, designed by award-winning stylists, exudes sophistication and comfort. REVERIE offers accommodations for up to 12 guests in six comfortable staterooms, each with a private ensuite.

Starting from the aft deck, you will step onto a spacious haven for relaxation, equipped with comfortable seating, advanced entertainment features, and a full wet bar. Just steps away is the extended swim platform is perfect for an abundance of aquatic activities. As you enter REVERIE’s main salon you are greeted by an expansive, open concept living space. The lavish interior sports chic furnishings and custom finishes throughout the sprawling open layout. Nearby, the dining area features space for up to ten at the dining table, and a custom-built extensive wine cooler. Adjacent to the dining space, a sleek, fully equipped galley is hidden behind a partition, allowing the crew to prepare delicious meals without disturbing the guests.

Continuing forward on the main deck, the full beam owner’s stateroom is a sanctuary of comfort and style. It includes a king bed, seating area, private study, and large marble ensuite featuring his-and-hers sinks with gold bathroom fixtures and a plunge tub. Adjacent to the owner’s suite is the VIP stateroom, with a walk-around queen bed and private ensuite.

Descending the central staircase to the lower deck you will find the additional four staterooms, each with king-size beds and luxurious bedding, top-tier entertainment systems, and unique decor. Two of the suites are convertible to twin staterooms to suit any guests needs. Central to these staterooms you will find a convenient pantry, offering an array of refreshments. Also on the lower deck are the crew quarters, room for 12 and privately situated as to not disturb guests.

Retreat up to the sky lounge for an oasis of sophistication complimented by stunning panoramic ocean views while relaxing on the crescent-shaped sofa or sitting at the games table. Out on the upper aft deck, experience a spacious area perfect for lounging and dining al fresco. A large dining table makes this an ideal spot for any occasion, from causal gatherings to elegant events. Or spend some time on the forward bridge deck in a quiet space with cozy seating. Nearby, on the starboard side deck, a shaded gym and spa make this spot a great place for peace, privacy, and relaxation.

Atop Reverie, the sundeck is the epitome of luxury. It features lavish seating, casual outdoor dining, a stylish wet bar, and sun pads encircling a magnificent Jacuzzi. Whether it’s enjoying a cocktail at sunset or a late-night dip in the Jacuzzi, the sun deck is designed for ultimate relaxation and unparalleled ocean views.

From the spacious living areas and the sprawling decks to being equipped with state-of-the-art technology and engineering, REVERIE is a seamless blend of luxury and efficiency. Expansive deck space is plentiful on all three levels, providing several functional places for both entertainment and relaxation. REVERIE’s accommodations are designed to provide an intimate and serene retreat for every guest.

*Not for sale to US residents while in US waters.*

REVERIE is a magnificent 165’ (50m) superyacht crafted to perfection by the renowned Feadship shipyard. She was delivered in 2000, fully refitted in 2017 with a new interior, and received several major upgrades in the past two years, ensuring she remains at the forefront of modern luxury while retaining her classic charm. The décor and styling of both the exterior and interior, designed by award-winning stylists, exudes sophistication and comfort. REVERIE offers accommodations for up to 12 guests in six comfortable staterooms, each with a private ensuite.

Starting from the aft deck, you will step onto a spacious haven for relaxation, equipped with comfortable seating, advanced entertainment features, and a full wet bar. Just steps away is the extended swim platform is perfect for an abundance of aquatic activities. As you enter REVERIE’s main salon you are greeted by an expansive, open concept living space. The lavish interior sports chic furnishings and custom finishes throughout the sprawling open layout. Nearby, the dining area features space for up to ten at the dining table, and a custom-built extensive wine cooler. Adjacent to the dining space, a sleek, fully equipped galley is hidden behind a partition, allowing the crew to prepare delicious meals without disturbing the guests.

Continuing forward on the main deck, the full beam owner’s stateroom is a sanctuary of comfort and style. It includes a king bed, seating area, private study, and large marble ensuite featuring his-and-hers sinks with gold bathroom fixtures and a plunge tub. Adjacent to the owner’s suite is the VIP stateroom, with a walk-around queen bed and private ensuite.

Descending the central staircase to the lower deck you will find the additional four staterooms, each with king-size beds and luxurious bedding, top-tier entertainment systems, and unique decor. Two of the suites are convertible to twin staterooms to suit any guests needs. Central to these staterooms you will find a convenient pantry, offering an array of refreshments. Also on the lower deck are the crew quarters, room for 12 and privately situated as to not disturb guests.

Retreat up to the sky lounge for an oasis of sophistication complimented by stunning panoramic ocean views while relaxing on the crescent-shaped sofa or sitting at the games table. Out on the upper aft deck, experience a spacious area perfect for lounging and dining al fresco. A large dining table makes this an ideal spot for any occasion, from causal gatherings to elegant events. Or spend some time on the forward bridge deck in a quiet space with cozy seating. Nearby, on the starboard side deck, a shaded gym and spa make this spot a great place for peace, privacy, and relaxation.

Atop Reverie, the sundeck is the epitome of luxury. It features lavish seating, casual outdoor dining, a stylish wet bar, and sun pads encircling a magnificent Jacuzzi. Whether it’s enjoying a cocktail at sunset or a late-night dip in the Jacuzzi, the sun deck is designed for ultimate relaxation and unparalleled ocean views.

From the spacious living areas and the sprawling decks to being equipped with state-of-the-art technology and engineering, REVERIE is a seamless blend of luxury and efficiency. Expansive deck space is plentiful on all three levels, providing several functional places for both entertainment and relaxation. REVERIE’s accommodations are designed to provide an intimate and serene retreat for every guest.

*Not for sale to US residents while in US waters.*

"AvailableCoBroker": 1, "ShowOnOtherCompaniesSites": false, "VesselDescriptionShortDescription": "

REVERIE is a magnificent 165’ (50m) superyacht crafted to perfection by the renowned Feadship shipyard. She was delivered in 2000, fully refitted in 2017 with a new interior, and received several major upgrades in the past two years, ensuring she remains at the forefront of modern luxury while retaining her classic charm. The décor and styling of both the exterior and interior, designed by award-winning stylists, exudes sophistication and comfort. REVERIE offers accommodations for up to 12 guests in six comfortable staterooms, each with a private ensuite.

Starting from the aft deck, you will step onto a spacious haven for relaxation, equipped with comfortable seating, advanced entertainment features, and a full wet bar. Just steps away is the extended swim platform is perfect for an abundance of aquatic activities. As you enter REVERIE’s main salon you are greeted by an expansive, open concept living space. The lavish interior sports chic furnishings and custom finishes throughout the sprawling open layout. Nearby, the dining area features space for up to ten at the dining table, and a custom-built extensive wine cooler. Adjacent to the dining space, a sleek, fully equipped galley is hidden behind a partition, allowing the crew to prepare delicious meals without disturbing the guests.

Continuing forward on the main deck, the full beam owner’s stateroom is a sanctuary of comfort and style. It includes a king bed, seating area, private study, and large marble ensuite featuring his-and-hers sinks with gold bathroom fixtures and a plunge tub. Adjacent to the owner’s suite is the VIP stateroom, with a walk-around queen bed and private ensuite.

Descending the central staircase to the lower deck you will find the additional four staterooms, each with king-size beds and luxurious bedding, top-tier entertainment systems, and unique decor. Two of the suites are convertible to twin staterooms to suit any guests needs. Central to these staterooms you will find a convenient pantry, offering an array of refreshments. Also on the lower deck are the crew quarters, room for 12 and privately situated as to not disturb guests.

Retreat up to the sky lounge for an oasis of sophistication complimented by stunning panoramic ocean views while relaxing on the crescent-shaped sofa or sitting at the games table. Out on the upper aft deck, experience a spacious area perfect for lounging and dining al fresco. A large dining table makes this an ideal spot for any occasion, from causal gatherings to elegant events. Or spend some time on the forward bridge deck in a quiet space with cozy seating. Nearby, on the starboard side deck, a shaded gym and spa make this spot a great place for peace, privacy, and relaxation.

Atop Reverie, the sundeck is the epitome of luxury. It features lavish seating, casual outdoor dining, a stylish wet bar, and sun pads encircling a magnificent Jacuzzi. Whether it’s enjoying a cocktail at sunset or a late-night dip in the Jacuzzi, the sun deck is designed for ultimate relaxation and unparalleled ocean views.

From the spacious living areas and the sprawling decks to being equipped with state-of-the-art technology and engineering, REVERIE is a seamless blend of luxury and efficiency. Expansive deck space is plentiful on all three levels, providing several functional places for both entertainment and relaxation. REVERIE’s accommodations are designed to provide an intimate and serene retreat for every guest.

*Not for sale to US residents while in US waters.*

REVERIE is a magnificent 165’ (50m) superyacht crafted to perfection by the renowned Feadship shipyard. She was delivered in 2000, fully refitted in 2017 with a new interior, and received several major upgrades in the past two years, ensuring she remains at the forefront of modern luxury while retaining her classic charm. The décor and styling of both the exterior and interior, designed by award-winning stylists, exudes sophistication and comfort. REVERIE offers accommodations for up to 12 guests in six comfortable staterooms, each with a private ensuite.

Starting from the aft deck, you will step onto a spacious haven for relaxation, equipped with comfortable seating, advanced entertainment features, and a full wet bar. Just steps away is the extended swim platform is perfect for an abundance of aquatic activities. As you enter REVERIE’s main salon you are greeted by an expansive, open concept living space. The lavish interior sports chic furnishings and custom finishes throughout the sprawling open layout. Nearby, the dining area features space for up to ten at the dining table, and a custom-built extensive wine cooler. Adjacent to the dining space, a sleek, fully equipped galley is hidden behind a partition, allowing the crew to prepare delicious meals without disturbing the guests.

Continuing forward on the main deck, the full beam owner’s stateroom is a sanctuary of comfort and style. It includes a king bed, seating area, private study, and large marble ensuite featuring his-and-hers sinks with gold bathroom fixtures and a plunge tub. Adjacent to the owner’s suite is the VIP stateroom, with a walk-around queen bed and private ensuite.

Descending the central staircase to the lower deck you will find the additional four staterooms, each with king-size beds and luxurious bedding, top-tier entertainment systems, and unique decor. Two of the suites are convertible to twin staterooms to suit any guests needs. Central to these staterooms you will find a convenient pantry, offering an array of refreshments. Also on the lower deck are the crew quarters, room for 12 and privately situated as to not disturb guests.

Retreat up to the sky lounge for an oasis of sophistication complimented by stunning panoramic ocean views while relaxing on the crescent-shaped sofa or sitting at the games table. Out on the upper aft deck, experience a spacious area perfect for lounging and dining al fresco. A large dining table makes this an ideal spot for any occasion, from causal gatherings to elegant events. Or spend some time on the forward bridge deck in a quiet space with cozy seating. Nearby, on the starboard side deck, a shaded gym and spa make this spot a great place for peace, privacy, and relaxation.

Atop Reverie, the sundeck is the epitome of luxury. It features lavish seating, casual outdoor dining, a stylish wet bar, and sun pads encircling a magnificent Jacuzzi. Whether it’s enjoying a cocktail at sunset or a late-night dip in the Jacuzzi, the sun deck is designed for ultimate relaxation and unparalleled ocean views.

From the spacious living areas and the sprawling decks to being equipped with state-of-the-art technology and engineering, REVERIE is a seamless blend of luxury and efficiency. Expansive deck space is plentiful on all three levels, providing several functional places for both entertainment and relaxation. REVERIE’s accommodations are designed to provide an intimate and serene retreat for every guest.

*Not for sale to US residents while in US waters.*

"AvailableCoBroker": 1, "ShowOnOtherCompaniesSites": false, "VesselDescriptionShortDescription": "

REVERIE is a magnificent 165’ (50m) superyacht crafted to perfection by the renowned Feadship shipyard. She was delivered in 2000, fully refitted in 2017 with a new interior, and received several major upgrades in the past two years, ensuring she remains at the forefront of modern luxury while retaining her classic charm. The décor and styling of both the exterior and interior, designed by award-winning stylists, exudes sophistication and comfort. REVERIE offers accommodations for up to 12 guests in six comfortable staterooms, each with a private ensuite.

Starting from the aft deck, you will step onto a spacious haven for relaxation, equipped with comfortable seating, advanced entertainment features, and a full wet bar. Just steps away is the extended swim platform is perfect for an abundance of aquatic activities. As you enter REVERIE’s main salon you are greeted by an expansive, open concept living space. The lavish interior sports chic furnishings and custom finishes throughout the sprawling open layout. Nearby, the dining area features space for up to ten at the dining table, and a custom-built extensive wine cooler. Adjacent to the dining space, a sleek, fully equipped galley is hidden behind a partition, allowing the crew to prepare delicious meals without disturbing the guests.

Continuing forward on the main deck, the full beam owner’s stateroom is a sanctuary of comfort and style. It includes a king bed, seating area, private study, and large marble ensuite featuring his-and-hers sinks with gold bathroom fixtures and a plunge tub. Adjacent to the owner’s suite is the VIP stateroom, with a walk-around queen bed and private ensuite.

Descending the central staircase to the lower deck you will find the additional four staterooms, each with king-size beds and luxurious bedding, top-tier entertainment systems, and unique decor. Two of the suites are convertible to twin staterooms to suit any guests needs. Central to these staterooms you will find a convenient pantry, offering an array of refreshments. Also on the lower deck are the crew quarters, room for 12 and privately situated as to not disturb guests.

Retreat up to the sky lounge for an oasis of sophistication complimented by stunning panoramic ocean views while relaxing on the crescent-shaped sofa or sitting at the games table. Out on the upper aft deck, experience a spacious area perfect for lounging and dining al fresco. A large dining table makes this an ideal spot for any occasion, from causal gatherings to elegant events. Or spend some time on the forward bridge deck in a quiet space with cozy seating. Nearby, on the starboard side deck, a shaded gym and spa make this spot a great place for peace, privacy, and relaxation.

Atop Reverie, the sundeck is the epitome of luxury. It features lavish seating, casual outdoor dining, a stylish wet bar, and sun pads encircling a magnificent Jacuzzi. Whether it’s enjoying a cocktail at sunset or a late-night dip in the Jacuzzi, the sun deck is designed for ultimate relaxation and unparalleled ocean views.

From the spacious living areas and the sprawling decks to being equipped with state-of-the-art technology and engineering, REVERIE is a seamless blend of luxury and efficiency. Expansive deck space is plentiful on all three levels, providing several functional places for both entertainment and relaxation. REVERIE’s accommodations are designed to provide an intimate and serene retreat for every guest.

*Not for sale to US residents while in US waters.*

REVERIE is a magnificent 165’ (50m) superyacht crafted to perfection by the renowned Feadship shipyard. She was delivered in 2000, fully refitted in 2017 with a new interior, and received several major upgrades in the past two years, ensuring she remains at the forefront of modern luxury while retaining her classic charm. The décor and styling of both the exterior and interior, designed by award-winning stylists, exudes sophistication and comfort. REVERIE offers accommodations for up to 12 guests in six comfortable staterooms, each with a private ensuite.

Starting from the aft deck, you will step onto a spacious haven for relaxation, equipped with comfortable seating, advanced entertainment features, and a full wet bar. Just steps away is the extended swim platform is perfect for an abundance of aquatic activities. As you enter REVERIE’s main salon you are greeted by an expansive, open concept living space. The lavish interior sports chic furnishings and custom finishes throughout the sprawling open layout. Nearby, the dining area features space for up to ten at the dining table, and a custom-built extensive wine cooler. Adjacent to the dining space, a sleek, fully equipped galley is hidden behind a partition, allowing the crew to prepare delicious meals without disturbing the guests.

Continuing forward on the main deck, the full beam owner’s stateroom is a sanctuary of comfort and style. It includes a king bed, seating area, private study, and large marble ensuite featuring his-and-hers sinks with gold bathroom fixtures and a plunge tub. Adjacent to the owner’s suite is the VIP stateroom, with a walk-around queen bed and private ensuite.

Descending the central staircase to the lower deck you will find the additional four staterooms, each with king-size beds and luxurious bedding, top-tier entertainment systems, and unique decor. Two of the suites are convertible to twin staterooms to suit any guests needs. Central to these staterooms you will find a convenient pantry, offering an array of refreshments. Also on the lower deck are the crew quarters, room for 12 and privately situated as to not disturb guests.

Retreat up to the sky lounge for an oasis of sophistication complimented by stunning panoramic ocean views while relaxing on the crescent-shaped sofa or sitting at the games table. Out on the upper aft deck, experience a spacious area perfect for lounging and dining al fresco. A large dining table makes this an ideal spot for any occasion, from causal gatherings to elegant events. Or spend some time on the forward bridge deck in a quiet space with cozy seating. Nearby, on the starboard side deck, a shaded gym and spa make this spot a great place for peace, privacy, and relaxation.

Atop Reverie, the sundeck is the epitome of luxury. It features lavish seating, casual outdoor dining, a stylish wet bar, and sun pads encircling a magnificent Jacuzzi. Whether it’s enjoying a cocktail at sunset or a late-night dip in the Jacuzzi, the sun deck is designed for ultimate relaxation and unparalleled ocean views.

From the spacious living areas and the sprawling decks to being equipped with state-of-the-art technology and engineering, REVERIE is a seamless blend of luxury and efficiency. Expansive deck space is plentiful on all three levels, providing several functional places for both entertainment and relaxation. REVERIE’s accommodations are designed to provide an intimate and serene retreat for every guest.

*Not for sale to US residents while in US waters.*

"AvailableCoBroker": 1, "ShowOnOtherCompaniesSites": false, "VesselDescriptionShortDescription": "

REVERIE is a magnificent 165’ (50m) superyacht crafted to perfection by the renowned Feadship shipyard. She was delivered in 2000, fully refitted in 2017 with a new interior, and received several major upgrades in the past two years, ensuring she remains at the forefront of modern luxury while retaining her classic charm. The décor and styling of both the exterior and interior, designed by award-winning stylists, exudes sophistication and comfort. REVERIE offers accommodations for up to 12 guests in six comfortable staterooms, each with a private ensuite.

Starting from the aft deck, you will step onto a spacious haven for relaxation, equipped with comfortable seating, advanced entertainment features, and a full wet bar. Just steps away is the extended swim platform is perfect for an abundance of aquatic activities. As you enter REVERIE’s main salon you are greeted by an expansive, open concept living space. The lavish interior sports chic furnishings and custom finishes throughout the sprawling open layout. Nearby, the dining area features space for up to ten at the dining table, and a custom-built extensive wine cooler. Adjacent to the dining space, a sleek, fully equipped galley is hidden behind a partition, allowing the crew to prepare delicious meals without disturbing the guests.

Continuing forward on the main deck, the full beam owner’s stateroom is a sanctuary of comfort and style. It includes a king bed, seating area, private study, and large marble ensuite featuring his-and-hers sinks with gold bathroom fixtures and a plunge tub. Adjacent to the owner’s suite is the VIP stateroom, with a walk-around queen bed and private ensuite.

Descending the central staircase to the lower deck you will find the additional four staterooms, each with king-size beds and luxurious bedding, top-tier entertainment systems, and unique decor. Two of the suites are convertible to twin staterooms to suit any guests needs. Central to these staterooms you will find a convenient pantry, offering an array of refreshments. Also on the lower deck are the crew quarters, room for 12 and privately situated as to not disturb guests.

Retreat up to the sky lounge for an oasis of sophistication complimented by stunning panoramic ocean views while relaxing on the crescent-shaped sofa or sitting at the games table. Out on the upper aft deck, experience a spacious area perfect for lounging and dining al fresco. A large dining table makes this an ideal spot for any occasion, from causal gatherings to elegant events. Or spend some time on the forward bridge deck in a quiet space with cozy seating. Nearby, on the starboard side deck, a shaded gym and spa make this spot a great place for peace, privacy, and relaxation.

Atop Reverie, the sundeck is the epitome of luxury. It features lavish seating, casual outdoor dining, a stylish wet bar, and sun pads encircling a magnificent Jacuzzi. Whether it’s enjoying a cocktail at sunset or a late-night dip in the Jacuzzi, the sun deck is designed for ultimate relaxation and unparalleled ocean views.

From the spacious living areas and the sprawling decks to being equipped with state-of-the-art technology and engineering, REVERIE is a seamless blend of luxury and efficiency. Expansive deck space is plentiful on all three levels, providing several functional places for both entertainment and relaxation. REVERIE’s accommodations are designed to provide an intimate and serene retreat for every guest.

*Not for sale to US residents while in US waters.*

Princess Too

Overview

The Princess Too is a spectacular 47.55 m / 156′ (approx) custom motor yacht built in 1999 by Feadship (Netherlands). With naval architecture by De Voogt Naval Architects and interiors from Sam Sorgiovanni, she combines timeless craftsmanship, refined design and serious long-range capability. Recently refitted (major refit in 2017) and maintained to a high standard, she is an outstanding opportunity for the discerning buyer.

Key Features

  • Builder / Year: Feadship, 1999 (major refit 2017)

  • Length / Beam / Draft: 47.55 m (156′) / 8.84 m (29′) beam / 3.2 m (10′6″) draft

  • Gross Tonnage: 552 GT

  • Hull / Superstructure: Steel hull, aluminium superstructure, teak decks

  • Guest & Crew Accommodation: Accommodates 12 guests in 6 staterooms (1 Master, 1 VIP, 4 Twin) + up to 10 crew members

  • Performance & Range: Cruising speed ~12 kn, top speed ~14–15 kn, impressive range up to 4,500 nm at ~11 kn thanks to ~67,750–68,000 L fuel capacity

  • Build & Design Team: Exterior & naval architecture by De Voogt; interiors by Sam Sorgiovanni — a rare combination of pedigree and style.

  • Refit & Maintenance: Major refit completed in 2017, ensuring modern systems and updated finishes.

Interior & Layout Highlights

From the main deck forward, the full-beam master stateroom offers king-size accommodation, his & hers baths (including a spa pool tub + separate shower) and private lounging space — a level of luxury typically found only on much larger yachts.
Below deck amidships, the VIP stateroom features a queen berth, en-suite spa bath, and settee for relaxing. Four additional twin cabins accommodate guests comfortably, each with en-suite facilities.
The main salon enjoys oversized windows and abundant natural light, with a formal dining area seating a full party of twelve, while the aft deck seamlessly transitions to al-fresco lounging and dining. The sun deck (or flybridge) presents multiple seating zones, a wet bar and spa tub/sunpad area under a hard top.

Exterior & Deck Spaces

Exterior decks are generous for her size, offering expansive lounging and dining options. The aft deck features dual cocktail tables that convert to a full-size dining table, while forward sun pads, a flybridge wet bar and protected outdoor lounge area create an ideal social hub. The generous beam and classic Feadship proportions foster a stable, refined ride and excellent sea-keeping.

Technical & Systems

Powered by twin Caterpillar diesel engines (2 × 905 hp) with twin-screw propulsion, the yacht also features at-anchor stabilizers for exceptional comfort when stationary. The large fuel and water tanks (fuel ~67,750 L, water ~21,570 L) support extended voyages and cruising freedom.

Why This Yacht Stands Out

  • Feadship pedigree: Feadship is among the most respected names in superyacht construction, and a 47 m example with full Feadship build and custom design remains rare.

  • Long-range freedom: A 4,500 nm range opens passages or global cruising potential, beyond typical yachts of this size.

  • Refit condition: A thorough refit in 2017 keeps systems updated and reduces the risk of major work in the short term.

  • Luxurious layout: With a full-beam master on the main deck and multiple dedicated guest cabins, she offers comfort equal to much larger yachts but in a more manageable size.

  • Strong resale appeal: Yachts built by Feadship retain value well; the combination of size, brand, condition and design make her an attractive buy for owner-operators or charter potential.

Summary

The Princess Too offers an exceptional opportunity: a timeless 47.5 m Feadship built to superyacht standards, comprehensively refitted, with long-range capability and elegant accommodation. Ideal for an owner seeking craftmanship, reliability and style in a yacht size that remains versatile, efficient and highly desirable.

The second Feadship for American owner Herb Chambers who actively charters his yachts, Excellence II is a masculine looking modern design from Frits de Voogt with an interior by Australian designer Sam Sorgiovanni. It was Sorgiovanni’s first project as an independent having worked several years for Jon Bannenberg. The profile features an aggressively raked hull and matching step in the sheer line as well as square corners on her many-windowed bridge, not unlike The Highlander. Interestingly, #782 replaced Feadship #753, a 38.70-metre named simply, Excellence, launched in 1986.

Princess Too

Overview

The Princess Too is a spectacular 47.55 m / 156′ (approx) custom motor yacht built in 1999 by Feadship (Netherlands). With naval architecture by De Voogt Naval Architects and interiors from Sam Sorgiovanni, she combines timeless craftsmanship, refined design and serious long-range capability. Recently refitted (major refit in 2017) and maintained to a high standard, she is an outstanding opportunity for the discerning buyer.

Key Features

  • Builder / Year: Feadship, 1999 (major refit 2017)

  • Length / Beam / Draft: 47.55 m (156′) / 8.84 m (29′) beam / 3.2 m (10′6″) draft

  • Gross Tonnage: 552 GT

  • Hull / Superstructure: Steel hull, aluminium superstructure, teak decks

  • Guest & Crew Accommodation: Accommodates 12 guests in 6 staterooms (1 Master, 1 VIP, 4 Twin) + up to 10 crew members

  • Performance & Range: Cruising speed ~12 kn, top speed ~14–15 kn, impressive range up to 4,500 nm at ~11 kn thanks to ~67,750–68,000 L fuel capacity

  • Build & Design Team: Exterior & naval architecture by De Voogt; interiors by Sam Sorgiovanni — a rare combination of pedigree and style.

  • Refit & Maintenance: Major refit completed in 2017, ensuring modern systems and updated finishes.

Interior & Layout Highlights

From the main deck forward, the full-beam master stateroom offers king-size accommodation, his & hers baths (including a spa pool tub + separate shower) and private lounging space — a level of luxury typically found only on much larger yachts.
Below deck amidships, the VIP stateroom features a queen berth, en-suite spa bath, and settee for relaxing. Four additional twin cabins accommodate guests comfortably, each with en-suite facilities.
The main salon enjoys oversized windows and abundant natural light, with a formal dining area seating a full party of twelve, while the aft deck seamlessly transitions to al-fresco lounging and dining. The sun deck (or flybridge) presents multiple seating zones, a wet bar and spa tub/sunpad area under a hard top.

Exterior & Deck Spaces

Exterior decks are generous for her size, offering expansive lounging and dining options. The aft deck features dual cocktail tables that convert to a full-size dining table, while forward sun pads, a flybridge wet bar and protected outdoor lounge area create an ideal social hub. The generous beam and classic Feadship proportions foster a stable, refined ride and excellent sea-keeping.

Technical & Systems

Powered by twin Caterpillar diesel engines (2 × 905 hp) with twin-screw propulsion, the yacht also features at-anchor stabilizers for exceptional comfort when stationary. The large fuel and water tanks (fuel ~67,750 L, water ~21,570 L) support extended voyages and cruising freedom.

Why This Yacht Stands Out

  • Feadship pedigree: Feadship is among the most respected names in superyacht construction, and a 47 m example with full Feadship build and custom design remains rare.

  • Long-range freedom: A 4,500 nm range opens passages or global cruising potential, beyond typical yachts of this size.

  • Refit condition: A thorough refit in 2017 keeps systems updated and reduces the risk of major work in the short term.

  • Luxurious layout: With a full-beam master on the main deck and multiple dedicated guest cabins, she offers comfort equal to much larger yachts but in a more manageable size.

  • Strong resale appeal: Yachts built by Feadship retain value well; the combination of size, brand, condition and design make her an attractive buy for owner-operators or charter potential.

Summary

The Princess Too offers an exceptional opportunity: a timeless 47.5 m Feadship built to superyacht standards, comprehensively refitted, with long-range capability and elegant accommodation. Ideal for an owner seeking craftmanship, reliability and style in a yacht size that remains versatile, efficient and highly desirable.

Princess Too

Overview

The Princess Too is a spectacular 47.55 m / 156′ (approx) custom motor yacht built in 1999 by Feadship (Netherlands). With naval architecture by De Voogt Naval Architects and interiors from Sam Sorgiovanni, she combines timeless craftsmanship, refined design and serious long-range capability. Recently refitted (major refit in 2017) and maintained to a high standard, she is an outstanding opportunity for the discerning buyer.

Key Features

  • Builder / Year: Feadship, 1999 (major refit 2017)

  • Length / Beam / Draft: 47.55 m (156′) / 8.84 m (29′) beam / 3.2 m (10′6″) draft

  • Gross Tonnage: 552 GT

  • Hull / Superstructure: Steel hull, aluminium superstructure, teak decks

  • Guest & Crew Accommodation: Accommodates 12 guests in 6 staterooms (1 Master, 1 VIP, 4 Twin) + up to 10 crew members

  • Performance & Range: Cruising speed ~12 kn, top speed ~14–15 kn, impressive range up to 4,500 nm at ~11 kn thanks to ~67,750–68,000 L fuel capacity

  • Build & Design Team: Exterior & naval architecture by De Voogt; interiors by Sam Sorgiovanni — a rare combination of pedigree and style.

  • Refit & Maintenance: Major refit completed in 2017, ensuring modern systems and updated finishes.

Interior & Layout Highlights

From the main deck forward, the full-beam master stateroom offers king-size accommodation, his & hers baths (including a spa pool tub + separate shower) and private lounging space — a level of luxury typically found only on much larger yachts.
Below deck amidships, the VIP stateroom features a queen berth, en-suite spa bath, and settee for relaxing. Four additional twin cabins accommodate guests comfortably, each with en-suite facilities.
The main salon enjoys oversized windows and abundant natural light, with a formal dining area seating a full party of twelve, while the aft deck seamlessly transitions to al-fresco lounging and dining. The sun deck (or flybridge) presents multiple seating zones, a wet bar and spa tub/sunpad area under a hard top.

Exterior & Deck Spaces

Exterior decks are generous for her size, offering expansive lounging and dining options. The aft deck features dual cocktail tables that convert to a full-size dining table, while forward sun pads, a flybridge wet bar and protected outdoor lounge area create an ideal social hub. The generous beam and classic Feadship proportions foster a stable, refined ride and excellent sea-keeping.

Technical & Systems

Powered by twin Caterpillar diesel engines (2 × 905 hp) with twin-screw propulsion, the yacht also features at-anchor stabilizers for exceptional comfort when stationary. The large fuel and water tanks (fuel ~67,750 L, water ~21,570 L) support extended voyages and cruising freedom.

Why This Yacht Stands Out

  • Feadship pedigree: Feadship is among the most respected names in superyacht construction, and a 47 m example with full Feadship build and custom design remains rare.

  • Long-range freedom: A 4,500 nm range opens passages or global cruising potential, beyond typical yachts of this size.

  • Refit condition: A thorough refit in 2017 keeps systems updated and reduces the risk of major work in the short term.

  • Luxurious layout: With a full-beam master on the main deck and multiple dedicated guest cabins, she offers comfort equal to much larger yachts but in a more manageable size.

  • Strong resale appeal: Yachts built by Feadship retain value well; the combination of size, brand, condition and design make her an attractive buy for owner-operators or charter potential.

Summary

The Princess Too offers an exceptional opportunity: a timeless 47.5 m Feadship built to superyacht standards, comprehensively refitted, with long-range capability and elegant accommodation. Ideal for an owner seeking craftmanship, reliability and style in a yacht size that remains versatile, efficient and highly desirable.

Princess Too

Overview

The Princess Too is a spectacular 47.55 m / 156′ (approx) custom motor yacht built in 1999 by Feadship (Netherlands). With naval architecture by De Voogt Naval Architects and interiors from Sam Sorgiovanni, she combines timeless craftsmanship, refined design and serious long-range capability. Recently refitted (major refit in 2017) and maintained to a high standard, she is an outstanding opportunity for the discerning buyer.

Key Features

  • Builder / Year: Feadship, 1999 (major refit 2017)

  • Length / Beam / Draft: 47.55 m (156′) / 8.84 m (29′) beam / 3.2 m (10′6″) draft

  • Gross Tonnage: 552 GT

  • Hull / Superstructure: Steel hull, aluminium superstructure, teak decks

  • Guest & Crew Accommodation: Accommodates 12 guests in 6 staterooms (1 Master, 1 VIP, 4 Twin) + up to 10 crew members

  • Performance & Range: Cruising speed ~12 kn, top speed ~14–15 kn, impressive range up to 4,500 nm at ~11 kn thanks to ~67,750–68,000 L fuel capacity

  • Build & Design Team: Exterior & naval architecture by De Voogt; interiors by Sam Sorgiovanni — a rare combination of pedigree and style.

  • Refit & Maintenance: Major refit completed in 2017, ensuring modern systems and updated finishes.

Interior & Layout Highlights

From the main deck forward, the full-beam master stateroom offers king-size accommodation, his & hers baths (including a spa pool tub + separate shower) and private lounging space — a level of luxury typically found only on much larger yachts.
Below deck amidships, the VIP stateroom features a queen berth, en-suite spa bath, and settee for relaxing. Four additional twin cabins accommodate guests comfortably, each with en-suite facilities.
The main salon enjoys oversized windows and abundant natural light, with a formal dining area seating a full party of twelve, while the aft deck seamlessly transitions to al-fresco lounging and dining. The sun deck (or flybridge) presents multiple seating zones, a wet bar and spa tub/sunpad area under a hard top.

Exterior & Deck Spaces

Exterior decks are generous for her size, offering expansive lounging and dining options. The aft deck features dual cocktail tables that convert to a full-size dining table, while forward sun pads, a flybridge wet bar and protected outdoor lounge area create an ideal social hub. The generous beam and classic Feadship proportions foster a stable, refined ride and excellent sea-keeping.

Technical & Systems

Powered by twin Caterpillar diesel engines (2 × 905 hp) with twin-screw propulsion, the yacht also features at-anchor stabilizers for exceptional comfort when stationary. The large fuel and water tanks (fuel ~67,750 L, water ~21,570 L) support extended voyages and cruising freedom.

Why This Yacht Stands Out

  • Feadship pedigree: Feadship is among the most respected names in superyacht construction, and a 47 m example with full Feadship build and custom design remains rare.

  • Long-range freedom: A 4,500 nm range opens passages or global cruising potential, beyond typical yachts of this size.

  • Refit condition: A thorough refit in 2017 keeps systems updated and reduces the risk of major work in the short term.

  • Luxurious layout: With a full-beam master on the main deck and multiple dedicated guest cabins, she offers comfort equal to much larger yachts but in a more manageable size.

  • Strong resale appeal: Yachts built by Feadship retain value well; the combination of size, brand, condition and design make her an attractive buy for owner-operators or charter potential.

Summary

The Princess Too offers an exceptional opportunity: a timeless 47.5 m Feadship built to superyacht standards, comprehensively refitted, with long-range capability and elegant accommodation. Ideal for an owner seeking craftmanship, reliability and style in a yacht size that remains versatile, efficient and highly desirable.

Refit history under current ownership 

Winter 2021/2022 - Lloyds special survey no. 5 and various other refit works all carried out by Feadship at their refit facility in Amsterdam, including: 

Major overhaul of both generators (carried out by Pon Power NL)
Removal and overhaul of both gearboxes for service (carried out by the manufacturer Reintjes)
Complete withdrawal of both tail-shafts by Akerboom
Check, polish and balance of both propellers
Removal and complete service of both overhead davit cranes for tender launching. (Carried out by Van Driel the manufacturer)
Opening sandblasting and repainting of all sanitary tanks (black and grey water)
Opening sandblasting and repainting of all fresh water tanks
Complete sandblasting of the underwater area of the hull and new paint system applied from Primer coats upward. JOTUN paints
New replacement fire extinguishers throughout the vessel.
Standard survey items such as servicing/testing valves and hull inspections etc… carried out at Feadship by De Vries

In addition following vessel improvements: 
Complete new CCTV system added to monitor the vessel security and heliops Panasonic.
Installation of new Sarlink Maritime system for fast internet access
Complete replacement of all the freshwater pipework throughout the yacht with new MEPLA pipe
New boilers and storage tanks for the hot water system
New pump system for the fresh water system
Extension of the helideck to enable more space for a larger helicopter complete new helideck surface and markings added
Strengthening the helideck with additional pillars on the bridge and main deck to spread load of a larger helicopter and meet the current load requirements for HLA under Lloyds
Addition of 2 fuel tanks (1900L each) and a dual pump system for refuelling a helicopter with Jet A1 aviation fuel was added to the Lazarette (manufacturer Sypack Doedijns)
Addition of a Helideck Monitoring system – (supplied by Kongsberg)
Addition of a deionized water system to allow flushing of a helicopter turbine aboard
Addition of a GPU – Ground Power Unit – Suitable for an H135 helicopter was also added to the helideck area.
Helideck lighting and illumination in line with Aviation and Flag requirements

FLAG STATE required helicopter operation to fall as “closely as possible” into line with their commercial code, this meant additional operational safety features were required as follows:
Installation of DIFFs – 3 pop up nozzles for remote activated foam dispensing added to the helideck, a new separate pump system and foam reservoir added to the engine room.
Installation of a NOVAK extinguishing system and a water mist drench system to the lazarette
Replacement and installation of new Steel scupper system for the helideck area.
Additional portable fire fighting systems also purchased for the helideck
New escape ladder made to allow simple access over the top of the bridge to the foredeck.
New fold down railing system around the helideck area to allow quick preparation for heliops and quick reinstallation upon landing
The life raft mountings were also moved further forward to keep clear of the helideck
Full set of tie down points for the helicopter deck were added and a secondary set further forward to allow long distance transport of the helicopter if required.
Professional consultation with Helidecks UK throughout the project.  Writing of a vessel specific manual and crew training also supplied.
* The helideck is not a commercial landing area and due to the size of the vessel cannot comply fully, but all efforts were made to ensure this is a safe and viable operational area for a helicopter up to 3T, based on the H135 machine as the most likely.
Please note the vessel returned to Amsterdam in September 2022 for two months this included re-surfacing the helideck under warranty and some paint warranty items

Spring 2021 
Complete new galley 
Winter 2019/20 
Complete repaint of the yacht. Warranty extended to June 2022 extensive replacement of Teak 
decks ( foredeck , bridgedeck and swim platform completely renewed ). 
Sundeck and main deck partial renewal and recaulk. All decks now have a minimum thickness  of 15mm . 
Gangway removed and painted, complete hydraulic service in Netherlands by Akerboom. 
New PLC control for all aft hydraulics built by Akerboom. 
Both windlass’ removed and sent to Steen in Germany for complete rebuild. 
Partial sandblasting of the hull and treatment. Antifoul changed to Jotun Imperial. 
New Silver Ion water purification system added, with designated additional filtered drinking tap  for the crew, to reduce bottled water purchase/use. 
New Furuno depth sounder. 
New Sailor 900 VSAT. 
Two new Furuno Radars. 
New Transas Ecdis Computer installed with designated screen. 
New 4/5G antennae and PepWave system. 
"Pon" ( Dutch Caterpillar agents ) top end overhaul of both main  engines. (at approx. 29.000 hrs in Dec 2020)
"Pon"  re-alignment of main engine shafts, and replace engine and  gearbox mounts (Dec 2020)
Winter 2018/19 
"Pon" commissioned to completely overhaul  both generators. 
Remodel of upper deck bulwark to facilitate easier heliops. Touch and Go helipad able to receive  an MD 500. (Feadship quote available for strengthening to carry larger helicopters) . 
New Chiller unit for AC installed and all ducts cleaned, new duct heaters installed. New drives  and overhaul of all main airhandlers – all carried out by Heinen and Hopman. 
New Chiller unit for both the Cool Room and Freezer room carried out by Heinen and Hopman. 
Shafts withdrawn for Lloyds – work carried out by Akerboom. 
Both the custom tenders painted, engines overhauled and fabrics replaced. 
Carbon MOB crane installed on sundeck with bow socket option. 
Stabilizers withdrawn and serviced by Quantum approved contractor. 
Two new Cobham Sea Tel antennae for Satelite TV. 
New carpet and soft furnishings, and additional furniture throughout entire guest  accomodation. All fabrics used are aviation standard so they are fire retardant. Mainly from Loro Piana. 
New back lit onyx bar and side tables in main saloon. 
New projector screen in skylounge. 
All cushions and awnings renewed. 
New carpet in guest and owner areas. 
New electic Roman shades in owner and guest areas. 
New linen and towelling throughout. 
Winter 2017/18 
New throttle system and associated cables to Engine Room installed.  
VAT paid in 2018 
May 2017 
Completed 5-year Lloyd’s Class survey.

Refit history under current ownership 

Winter 2021/2022 - Lloyds special survey no. 5 and various other refit works all carried out by Feadship at their refit facility in Amsterdam, including: 

Major overhaul of both generators (carried out by Pon Power NL)
Removal and overhaul of both gearboxes for service (carried out by the manufacturer Reintjes)
Complete withdrawal of both tail-shafts by Akerboom
Check, polish and balance of both propellers
Removal and complete service of both overhead davit cranes for tender launching. (Carried out by Van Driel the manufacturer)
Opening sandblasting and repainting of all sanitary tanks (black and grey water)
Opening sandblasting and repainting of all fresh water tanks
Complete sandblasting of the underwater area of the hull and new paint system applied from Primer coats upward. JOTUN paints
New replacement fire extinguishers throughout the vessel.
Standard survey items such as servicing/testing valves and hull inspections etc… carried out at Feadship by De Vries

In addition following vessel improvements: 
Complete new CCTV system added to monitor the vessel security and heliops Panasonic.
Installation of new Sarlink Maritime system for fast internet access
Complete replacement of all the freshwater pipework throughout the yacht with new MEPLA pipe
New boilers and storage tanks for the hot water system
New pump system for the fresh water system
Extension of the helideck to enable more space for a larger helicopter complete new helideck surface and markings added
Strengthening the helideck with additional pillars on the bridge and main deck to spread load of a larger helicopter and meet the current load requirements for HLA under Lloyds
Addition of 2 fuel tanks (1900L each) and a dual pump system for refuelling a helicopter with Jet A1 aviation fuel was added to the Lazarette (manufacturer Sypack Doedijns)
Addition of a Helideck Monitoring system – (supplied by Kongsberg)
Addition of a deionized water system to allow flushing of a helicopter turbine aboard
Addition of a GPU – Ground Power Unit – Suitable for an H135 helicopter was also added to the helideck area.
Helideck lighting and illumination in line with Aviation and Flag requirements

FLAG STATE required helicopter operation to fall as “closely as possible” into line with their commercial code, this meant additional operational safety features were required as follows:
Installation of DIFFs – 3 pop up nozzles for remote activated foam dispensing added to the helideck, a new separate pump system and foam reservoir added to the engine room.
Installation of a NOVAK extinguishing system and a water mist drench system to the lazarette
Replacement and installation of new Steel scupper system for the helideck area.
Additional portable fire fighting systems also purchased for the helideck
New escape ladder made to allow simple access over the top of the bridge to the foredeck.
New fold down railing system around the helideck area to allow quick preparation for heliops and quick reinstallation upon landing
The life raft mountings were also moved further forward to keep clear of the helideck
Full set of tie down points for the helicopter deck were added and a secondary set further forward to allow long distance transport of the helicopter if required.
Professional consultation with Helidecks UK throughout the project.  Writing of a vessel specific manual and crew training also supplied.
* The helideck is not a commercial landing area and due to the size of the vessel cannot comply fully, but all efforts were made to ensure this is a safe and viable operational area for a helicopter up to 3T, based on the H135 machine as the most likely.
Please note the vessel returned to Amsterdam in September 2022 for two months this included re-surfacing the helideck under warranty and some paint warranty items

Spring 2021 
Complete new galley 
Winter 2019/20 
Complete repaint of the yacht. Warranty extended to June 2022 extensive replacement of Teak 
decks ( foredeck , bridgedeck and swim platform completely renewed ). 
Sundeck and main deck partial renewal and recaulk. All decks now have a minimum thickness  of 15mm . 
Gangway removed and painted, complete hydraulic service in Netherlands by Akerboom. 
New PLC control for all aft hydraulics built by Akerboom. 
Both windlass’ removed and sent to Steen in Germany for complete rebuild. 
Partial sandblasting of the hull and treatment. Antifoul changed to Jotun Imperial. 
New Silver Ion water purification system added, with designated additional filtered drinking tap  for the crew, to reduce bottled water purchase/use. 
New Furuno depth sounder. 
New Sailor 900 VSAT. 
Two new Furuno Radars. 
New Transas Ecdis Computer installed with designated screen. 
New 4/5G antennae and PepWave system. 
"Pon" ( Dutch Caterpillar agents ) top end overhaul of both main  engines. (at approx. 29.000 hrs in Dec 2020)
"Pon"  re-alignment of main engine shafts, and replace engine and  gearbox mounts (Dec 2020)
Winter 2018/19 
"Pon" commissioned to completely overhaul  both generators. 
Remodel of upper deck bulwark to facilitate easier heliops. Touch and Go helipad able to receive  an MD 500. (Feadship quote available for strengthening to carry larger helicopters) . 
New Chiller unit for AC installed and all ducts cleaned, new duct heaters installed. New drives  and overhaul of all main airhandlers – all carried out by Heinen and Hopman. 
New Chiller unit for both the Cool Room and Freezer room carried out by Heinen and Hopman. 
Shafts withdrawn for Lloyds – work carried out by Akerboom. 
Both the custom tenders painted, engines overhauled and fabrics replaced. 
Carbon MOB crane installed on sundeck with bow socket option. 
Stabilizers withdrawn and serviced by Quantum approved contractor. 
Two new Cobham Sea Tel antennae for Satelite TV. 
New carpet and soft furnishings, and additional furniture throughout entire guest  accomodation. All fabrics used are aviation standard so they are fire retardant. Mainly from Loro Piana. 
New back lit onyx bar and side tables in main saloon. 
New projector screen in skylounge. 
All cushions and awnings renewed. 
New carpet in guest and owner areas. 
New electic Roman shades in owner and guest areas. 
New linen and towelling throughout. 
Winter 2017/18 
New throttle system and associated cables to Engine Room installed.  
VAT paid in 2018 
May 2017 
Completed 5-year Lloyd’s Class survey.

Refit history under current ownership 

Winter 2021/2022 - Lloyds special survey no. 5 and various other refit works all carried out by Feadship at their refit facility in Amsterdam, including: 

Major overhaul of both generators (carried out by Pon Power NL)
Removal and overhaul of both gearboxes for service (carried out by the manufacturer Reintjes)
Complete withdrawal of both tail-shafts by Akerboom
Check, polish and balance of both propellers
Removal and complete service of both overhead davit cranes for tender launching. (Carried out by Van Driel the manufacturer)
Opening sandblasting and repainting of all sanitary tanks (black and grey water)
Opening sandblasting and repainting of all fresh water tanks
Complete sandblasting of the underwater area of the hull and new paint system applied from Primer coats upward. JOTUN paints
New replacement fire extinguishers throughout the vessel.
Standard survey items such as servicing/testing valves and hull inspections etc… carried out at Feadship by De Vries

In addition following vessel improvements: 
Complete new CCTV system added to monitor the vessel security and heliops Panasonic.
Installation of new Sarlink Maritime system for fast internet access
Complete replacement of all the freshwater pipework throughout the yacht with new MEPLA pipe
New boilers and storage tanks for the hot water system
New pump system for the fresh water system
Extension of the helideck to enable more space for a larger helicopter complete new helideck surface and markings added
Strengthening the helideck with additional pillars on the bridge and main deck to spread load of a larger helicopter and meet the current load requirements for HLA under Lloyds
Addition of 2 fuel tanks (1900L each) and a dual pump system for refuelling a helicopter with Jet A1 aviation fuel was added to the Lazarette (manufacturer Sypack Doedijns)
Addition of a Helideck Monitoring system – (supplied by Kongsberg)
Addition of a deionized water system to allow flushing of a helicopter turbine aboard
Addition of a GPU – Ground Power Unit – Suitable for an H135 helicopter was also added to the helideck area.
Helideck lighting and illumination in line with Aviation and Flag requirements

FLAG STATE required helicopter operation to fall as “closely as possible” into line with their commercial code, this meant additional operational safety features were required as follows:
Installation of DIFFs – 3 pop up nozzles for remote activated foam dispensing added to the helideck, a new separate pump system and foam reservoir added to the engine room.
Installation of a NOVAK extinguishing system and a water mist drench system to the lazarette
Replacement and installation of new Steel scupper system for the helideck area.
Additional portable fire fighting systems also purchased for the helideck
New escape ladder made to allow simple access over the top of the bridge to the foredeck.
New fold down railing system around the helideck area to allow quick preparation for heliops and quick reinstallation upon landing
The life raft mountings were also moved further forward to keep clear of the helideck
Full set of tie down points for the helicopter deck were added and a secondary set further forward to allow long distance transport of the helicopter if required.
Professional consultation with Helidecks UK throughout the project.  Writing of a vessel specific manual and crew training also supplied.
* The helideck is not a commercial landing area and due to the size of the vessel cannot comply fully, but all efforts were made to ensure this is a safe and viable operational area for a helicopter up to 3T, based on the H135 machine as the most likely.
Please note the vessel returned to Amsterdam in September 2022 for two months this included re-surfacing the helideck under warranty and some paint warranty items

Spring 2021 
Complete new galley 
Winter 2019/20 
Complete repaint of the yacht. Warranty extended to June 2022 extensive replacement of Teak 
decks ( foredeck , bridgedeck and swim platform completely renewed ). 
Sundeck and main deck partial renewal and recaulk. All decks now have a minimum thickness  of 15mm . 
Gangway removed and painted, complete hydraulic service in Netherlands by Akerboom. 
New PLC control for all aft hydraulics built by Akerboom. 
Both windlass’ removed and sent to Steen in Germany for complete rebuild. 
Partial sandblasting of the hull and treatment. Antifoul changed to Jotun Imperial. 
New Silver Ion water purification system added, with designated additional filtered drinking tap  for the crew, to reduce bottled water purchase/use. 
New Furuno depth sounder. 
New Sailor 900 VSAT. 
Two new Furuno Radars. 
New Transas Ecdis Computer installed with designated screen. 
New 4/5G antennae and PepWave system. 
"Pon" ( Dutch Caterpillar agents ) top end overhaul of both main  engines. (at approx. 29.000 hrs in Dec 2020)
"Pon"  re-alignment of main engine shafts, and replace engine and  gearbox mounts (Dec 2020)
Winter 2018/19 
"Pon" commissioned to completely overhaul  both generators. 
Remodel of upper deck bulwark to facilitate easier heliops. Touch and Go helipad able to receive  an MD 500. (Feadship quote available for strengthening to carry larger helicopters) . 
New Chiller unit for AC installed and all ducts cleaned, new duct heaters installed. New drives  and overhaul of all main airhandlers – all carried out by Heinen and Hopman. 
New Chiller unit for both the Cool Room and Freezer room carried out by Heinen and Hopman. 
Shafts withdrawn for Lloyds – work carried out by Akerboom. 
Both the custom tenders painted, engines overhauled and fabrics replaced. 
Carbon MOB crane installed on sundeck with bow socket option. 
Stabilizers withdrawn and serviced by Quantum approved contractor. 
Two new Cobham Sea Tel antennae for Satelite TV. 
New carpet and soft furnishings, and additional furniture throughout entire guest  accomodation. All fabrics used are aviation standard so they are fire retardant. Mainly from Loro Piana. 
New back lit onyx bar and side tables in main saloon. 
New projector screen in skylounge. 
All cushions and awnings renewed. 
New carpet in guest and owner areas. 
New electic Roman shades in owner and guest areas. 
New linen and towelling throughout. 
Winter 2017/18 
New throttle system and associated cables to Engine Room installed.  
VAT paid in 2018

Refit history under current ownership 

Winter 2021/2022 - Lloyds special survey no. 5 and various other refit works all carried out by Feadship at their refit facility in Amsterdam, including: 

Major overhaul of both generators (carried out by Pon Power NL)
Removal and overhaul of both gearboxes for service (carried out by the manufacturer Reintjes)
Complete withdrawal of both tail-shafts by Akerboom
Check, polish and balance of both propellers
Removal and complete service of both overhead davit cranes for tender launching. (Carried out by Van Driel the manufacturer)
Opening sandblasting and repainting of all sanitary tanks (black and grey water)
Opening sandblasting and repainting of all fresh water tanks
Complete sandblasting of the underwater area of the hull and new paint system applied from Primer coats upward. JOTUN paints
New replacement fire extinguishers throughout the vessel.
Standard survey items such as servicing/testing valves and hull inspections etc… carried out at Feadship by De Vries

In addition following vessel improvements: 
Complete new CCTV system added to monitor the vessel security and heliops Panasonic.
Installation of new Sarlink Maritime system for fast internet access
Complete replacement of all the freshwater pipework throughout the yacht with new MEPLA pipe
New boilers and storage tanks for the hot water system
New pump system for the fresh water system
Extension of the helideck to enable more space for a larger helicopter complete new helideck surface and markings added
Strengthening the helideck with additional pillars on the bridge and main deck to spread load of a larger helicopter and meet the current load requirements for HLA under Lloyds
Addition of 2 fuel tanks (1900L each) and a dual pump system for refuelling a helicopter with Jet A1 aviation fuel was added to the Lazarette (manufacturer Sypack Doedijns)
Addition of a Helideck Monitoring system – (supplied by Kongsberg)
Addition of a deionized water system to allow flushing of a helicopter turbine aboard
Addition of a GPU – Ground Power Unit – Suitable for an H135 helicopter was also added to the helideck area.
Helideck lighting and illumination in line with Aviation and Flag requirements

FLAG STATE required helicopter operation to fall as “closely as possible” into line with their commercial code, this meant additional operational safety features were required as follows:
Installation of DIFFs – 3 pop up nozzles for remote activated foam dispensing added to the helideck, a new separate pump system and foam reservoir added to the engine room.
Installation of a NOVAK extinguishing system and a water mist drench system to the lazarette
Replacement and installation of new Steel scupper system for the helideck area.
Additional portable fire fighting systems also purchased for the helideck
New escape ladder made to allow simple access over the top of the bridge to the foredeck.
New fold down railing system around the helideck area to allow quick preparation for heliops and quick reinstallation upon landing
The life raft mountings were also moved further forward to keep clear of the helideck
Full set of tie down points for the helicopter deck were added and a secondary set further forward to allow long distance transport of the helicopter if required.
Professional consultation with Helidecks UK throughout the project.  Writing of a vessel specific manual and crew training also supplied.
* The helideck is not a commercial landing area and due to the size of the vessel cannot comply fully, but all efforts were made to ensure this is a safe and viable operational area for a helicopter up to 3T, based on the H135 machine as the most likely.
Please note the vessel returned to Amsterdam in September 2022 for two months this included re-surfacing the helideck under warranty and some paint warranty items

Complete new galley

Complete repaint of the yacht. Warranty extended to June 2022 extensive replacement of Teak 
decks ( foredeck , bridgedeck and swim platform completely renewed ). 
Sundeck and main deck partial renewal and recaulk. All decks now have a minimum thickness  of 15mm . 
Gangway removed and painted, complete hydraulic service in Netherlands by Akerboom. 
New PLC control for all aft hydraulics built by Akerboom. 
Both windlass’ removed and sent to Steen in Germany for complete rebuild. 
Partial sandblasting of the hull and treatment. Antifoul changed to Jotun Imperial. 
New Silver Ion water purification system added, with designated additional filtered drinking tap  for the crew, to reduce bottled water purchase/use. 
New Furuno depth sounder. 
New Sailor 900 VSAT. 
Two new Furuno Radars. 
New Transas Ecdis Computer installed with designated screen. 
New 4/5G antennae and PepWave system. 
"Pon" ( Dutch Caterpillar agents ) top end overhaul of both main  engines. (at approx. 29.000 hrs in Dec 2020)
"Pon"  re-alignment of main engine shafts, and replace engine and  gearbox mounts (Dec 2020)
Winter 2018/19 
"Pon" commissioned to completely overhaul  both generators. 
Remodel of upper deck bulwark to facilitate easier heliops. Touch and Go helipad able to receive  an MD 500. (Feadship quote available for strengthening to carry larger helicopters) . 
New Chiller unit for AC installed and all ducts cleaned, new duct heaters installed. New drives  and overhaul of all main airhandlers – all carried out by Heinen and Hopman. 
New Chiller unit for both the Cool Room and Freezer room carried out by Heinen and Hopman. 
Shafts withdrawn for Lloyds – work carried out by Akerboom. 
Both the custom tenders painted, engines overhauled and fabrics replaced. 
Carbon MOB crane installed on sundeck with bow socket option. 
Stabilizers withdrawn and serviced by Quantum approved contractor. 
Two new Cobham Sea Tel antennae for Satelite TV. 
New carpet and soft furnishings, and additional furniture throughout entire guest  accomodation. All fabrics used are aviation standard so they are fire retardant. Mainly from Loro Piana. 
New back lit onyx bar and side tables in main saloon. 
New projector screen in skylounge. 
All cushions and awnings renewed. 
New carpet in guest and owner areas. 
New electic Roman shades in owner and guest areas. 
New linen and towelling throughout. 
Winter 2017/18 
New throttle system and associated cables to Engine Room installed.  
VAT paid in 2018 
May 2017 
Completed 5-year Lloyd’s Class survey.

Having enjoyed several pleasurable years onboard his first 43.00-metre Sea Sedan, the owner poured all his experience into a second Sea Sedan. A modern, curvaceous exterior incorporated many special features, including extending the vertical oval windows to the guest accommodations in place of the traditional portholes, setting back the superstructure six inches to compensate for the full beam main deck, devising an intricate twisting structure for the outer stairways and fitting specially adapted hydraulics to transform the sun deck into a helicopter pad. Working closely with designer Terence Disdale, Sea Sedan’s owner gave his vision equally free rein in the palatial interior.

Radio room to starboard with dual workstations, pantry/flower pantry aft, day head further aft beside the elevator and staircase and access to the VIP or second master adjacent the elevator. VIP stateroom is almost full beam with corridor access aft on the starboard side to the full beam sky lounge or VIP lounge. The VIP aft deck outside has been modified to have wrap around seating around a dining table for 10 on starboard side and sun lounger seating to port.
 
SUN DECK:  One of the most efficient sundecks seen on a yacht this size. Two circular sun pads port and starboard sides forward. Storage lockers for cushions. Elevator and main staircase come out in the fully furnished “stack” and there is also a day head with shower with inside and outside access on the port side of the “funnel”. Outside at the aft end of the funnel is a U-shaped bar with stools, just ahead of a large hot tub. Port and starboard sides have U-shaped seating around coffee tables and the two deck cranes for the tenders store flush behind those settees so as to keep the deck clear for helicopter ops if desired. There are 3 steps down to the helicopter landing deck where the two tenders and wave runners are also stored.

Refit 2024/2025
all work done at Royal Van Lent Shipyard, Amsterdam
Poised for adventure with a fresh new look and enhanced performance, Olympus has undergone an extensive refit for 2024/2025, combining elevated guest comfort with cutting-edge operational upgrades.
 
Interior Elegance
From the guest cabins to the galley, every detail has been thoughtfully refined to reflect comfort, functionality, and timeless sophistication. Newly reupholstered guest chairs complement the yacht’s aesthetic, while meticulous carpentry touch-ups continue to elevate the interior ambiance. Guest carpets and exterior cushions have been professionally deep-cleaned and restored, delivering a fresh, revitalized atmosphere throughout.
 
Luxurious touches such as gold-polished and replated door handles and updated Roman blinds—replaced in the master and lower guest cabins—further enhance the refined environment.
 
In the galley, a brand-new professional grade cooking range, including ovens, fryers, and hobs, ensures seamless culinary service. Updated dry store shelving has transformed storage efficiency, while new flooring creates a modern, cohesive flow between the galley and crew areas. Additional improvements include upgraded guest toilet accessories and a fully restored walk-in fridge and freezer system, both performing at peak reliability.
 
Deck Enhancements
On deck, Olympus has received a full exterior refresh. All cushions and covers have been replaced, tables and bars re-varnished and wrapped, and the Jacuzzi completely overhauled. Re-hung and adjusted exterior doors now operate with precision, and striking stainless steel, backlit Olympus nameboards have been added to both sides of the vessel—amplifying her visual presence.
 
Bridge & Navigational Upgrades
A comprehensive bridge refit has brought Olympus in line with modern navigational standards. The console has been re-engineered with a sleek new leather finish, and a full suite of advanced navigation equipment has been installed. All navigation lights were upgraded to energy-efficient LED systems, and both depth sounders were modernized to improve redundancy and safety.
 
Mechanical & Technical Systems
A major overhaul of onboard systems focused on performance and reliability. This includes a fully new HVAC system, with two new air handling units and 20 new fan coil units to ensure superior climate control. The power management and alarm monitoring systems were upgraded to a state-of-the-art Praxis setup. Additionally, fuel tank level sensors were modernized, and a new variable speed drive was installed for the bow thruster.
 
Operational Efficiency
Operational improvements include the complete overhaul and repainting of all three onboard cranes, which were removed and reinstalled for optimal performance. The anchor windlass electrical systems were upgraded, and new dual anchor shackles were fitted to enhance deep anchoring capabilities. Below deck, the lazarette has been redesigned for improved layout and functionality, supporting a more efficient crew operation and ultimately enriching the guest experience.
