OLYMPUS is in many ways, the archetypal Feadship. She has the superior build quality and technical capabilities to take her all over the world. The sleek, well-designed exterior to turn heads in any port. And the space and versatility to accommodate any kind of group in absolute luxury. She was, after all, designed for royalty. Launched in 1996, she presents in absolutely pristine condition, thanks to the meticulous care of her current owner and crew, who have lovingly maintained her – with no expense spared - every Spring and Autumn since 2000.

She represents a fantastic opportunity to acquire an exceptionally well-maintained Feadship with a rich character and history. Capable of accommodating up to 16 guests across 8 generously sized cabins, she delivers both comfort and luxury within each of the guest cabins and staterooms. Guest accommodation has been carefully considered, with cabins available in different sizes, from single cabins to a grand VIP stateroom, a unique feature of hers.

The Master Suite includes a private lounge and office, an exercise room, a dining room and a lounge. Located on the bridge deck, the VIP suite was originally designed to accommodate the Sultan of Brunei, who never came onboard and was therefore never used until 2000. The port and starboard side double cabins have en suites with bath and shower along with his and her sinks. Can also be converted to a twin cabin, if required. Port and starboard side twin cabins have en suites with bath and shower. Port & starboard single cabins have en suites along with charming desk areas.

Her spacious interior, designed by London’s Winch Design, is splendidly classic with soothing light natural woods complemented by gold detailing along with cream and beige soft furnishings.

On the main deck, the voluminous main salon and dining area, office and exercise room sit adjacent to the spectacular owner’s stateroom, with its private forward lounge, walk-in wardrobe and spectacular bathroom, and can be used as an unofficial owner’s deck if required.

An ornate guest elevator and central staircase leads to the bridge deck, where a similarly sized – and equally luxurious – VIP stateroom can be found, along with a second salon with grand piano. The well-thought-out layout includes separate entrances and staircases for crew throughout the yacht to ensure discreet service.

Entertaining on a yacht has never been so easy thanks to the variety of outdoor areas she boasts. The sun deck is the outdoor area of choice, with a Jacuzzi perfectly placed near the incredibly ornate bar along with four other seating areas for soaking up the sun. Other outdoor areas include the bridge deck aft and main deck aft, both ideal for sundowners with friends or quiet family meals.

Under the direction of diligent owners, she has been impeccably and regularly maintained by the crew. With routine maintenance being consistently carried out every Spring and Autumn since 2000. She completed a significant yard period / refit at Monaco Marine in La Ciotat 2023.

While Stuart specializes in motor yachts, as a keen recreational sailor, he also has first-hand knowledge of the sailing yacht market and represents many Sellers or Buyers of large sailing yachts.

Port and starboard sides have U-shaped seating around coffee tables and the two deck cranes for the tenders store flush behind those settees so as to keep the deck clear for helicopter ops if desired. There are 3 steps down to the helicopter landing deck where the two tenders and wave runners are also stored.

Refit 2024/2025
all work done at Royal Van Lent Shipyard, Amsterdam
Poised for adventure with a fresh new look and enhanced performance, Olympus has undergone an extensive refit for 2024/2025, combining elevated guest comfort with cutting-edge operational upgrades.
 
Interior Elegance
From the guest cabins to the galley, every detail has been thoughtfully refined to reflect comfort, functionality, and timeless sophistication. Newly reupholstered guest chairs complement the yacht’s aesthetic, while meticulous carpentry touch-ups continue to elevate the interior ambiance. Guest carpets and exterior cushions have been professionally deep-cleaned and restored, delivering a fresh, revitalized atmosphere throughout.
 
Luxurious touches such as gold-polished and replated door handles and updated Roman blinds—replaced in the master and lower guest cabins—further enhance the refined environment.
 
In the galley, a brand-new professional grade cooking range, including ovens, fryers, and hobs, ensures seamless culinary service. Updated dry store shelving has transformed storage efficiency, while new flooring creates a modern, cohesive flow between the galley and crew areas. Additional improvements include upgraded guest toilet accessories and a fully restored walk-in fridge and freezer system, both performing at peak reliability.
 
Deck Enhancements
On deck, Olympus has received a full exterior refresh. All cushions and covers have been replaced, tables and bars re-varnished and wrapped, and the Jacuzzi completely overhauled. Re-hung and adjusted exterior doors now operate with precision, and striking stainless steel, backlit Olympus nameboards have been added to both sides of the vessel—amplifying her visual presence.
 
Bridge & Navigational Upgrades
A comprehensive bridge refit has brought Olympus in line with modern navigational standards. The console has been re-engineered with a sleek new leather finish, and a full suite of advanced navigation equipment has been installed. All navigation lights were upgraded to energy-efficient LED systems, and both depth sounders were modernized to improve redundancy and safety.
 
Mechanical & Technical Systems
A major overhaul of onboard systems focused on performance and reliability. This includes a fully new HVAC system, with two new air handling units and 20 new fan coil units to ensure superior climate control. The power management and alarm monitoring systems were upgraded to a state-of-the-art Praxis setup. Additionally, fuel tank level sensors were modernized, and a new variable speed drive was installed for the bow thruster.
 
Operational Efficiency
Operational improvements include the complete overhaul and repainting of all three onboard cranes, which were removed and reinstalled for optimal performance. The anchor windlass electrical systems were upgraded, and new dual anchor shackles were fitted to enhance deep anchoring capabilities. Below deck, the lazarette has been redesigned for improved layout and functionality, supporting a more efficient crew operation and ultimately enriching the guest experience.

{"Beam": 10, "City": "", "Open": false, "Year": 1996, "tags": [], "MLSID": 406680, "Length": 55, "Sleeps": 16, "EventID": 0, "IsModel": false, "LOAFeet": 180.44, "details": {"VD": {"VesselID": 406680, "CultureID": 1, "DataSource": 1, "VesselName": "Olympus", "CultureName": "English", "ExternalLink": "https://www.yachtolympus.com/", "CultureShortName": "EN", "Loading_ShortDescription": false, "Loading_MyWebSiteDescription": false, "VesselDescriptionBrokerTeaser": "", "Loading_YatcoDotComDescription": false, "VesselDescriptionInternalTeaser": "", "VesselDescriptionShortDescription": "

OLYMPUS is in many ways, the archetypal Feadship. She has the superior build quality and technical capabilities to take her all over the world. The sleek, well-designed exterior to turn heads in any port. And the space and versatility to accommodate any kind of group in absolute luxury. She was, after all, designed for royalty. Launched in 1996, she presents in absolutely pristine condition, thanks to the meticulous care of her current owner and crew, who have lovingly maintained her – with no expense spared - every Spring and Autumn since 2000.

She represents a fantastic opportunity to acquire an exceptionally well-maintained Feadship with a rich character and history. Capable of accommodating up to 16 guests across 8 generously sized cabins, she delivers both comfort and luxury within each of the guest cabins and staterooms. Guest accommodation has been carefully considered, with cabins available in different sizes, from single cabins to a grand VIP stateroom, a unique feature of hers.

The Master Suite includes a private lounge and office, an exercise room, a dining room and a lounge. Located on the bridge deck, the VIP suite was originally designed to accommodate the Sultan of Brunei, who never came onboard and was therefore never used until 2000. The port and starboard side double cabins have en suites with bath and shower along with his and her sinks. Can also be converted to a twin cabin, if required. Port and starboard side twin cabins have en suites with bath and shower. Port & starboard single cabins have en suites along with charming desk areas.

Her spacious interior, designed by London’s Winch Design, is splendidly classic with soothing light natural woods complemented by gold detailing along with cream and beige soft furnishings.

On the main deck, the voluminous main salon and dining area, office and exercise room sit adjacent to the spectacular owner’s stateroom, with its private forward lounge, walk-in wardrobe and spectacular bathroom, and can be used as an unofficial owner’s deck if required.

An ornate guest elevator and central staircase leads to the bridge deck, where a similarly sized – and equally luxurious – VIP stateroom can be found, along with a second salon with grand piano. The well-thought-out layout includes separate entrances and staircases for crew throughout the yacht to ensure discreet service.

Entertaining on a yacht has never been so easy thanks to the variety of outdoor areas she boasts. The sun deck is the outdoor area of choice, with a Jacuzzi perfectly placed near the incredibly ornate bar along with four other seating areas for soaking up the sun. Other outdoor areas include the bridge deck aft and main deck aft, both ideal for sundowners with friends or quiet family meals.

Under the direction of diligent owners, she has been impeccably and regularly maintained by the crew. With routine maintenance being consistently carried out every Spring and Autumn since 2000. She completed a significant yard period / refit at Monaco Marine in La Ciotat 2023.

false, "VesselDescriptionShortDescription": "

OLYMPUS is in many ways, the archetypal Feadship. She has the superior build quality and technical capabilities to take her all over the world. The sleek, well-designed exterior to turn heads in any port. And the space and versatility to accommodate any kind of group in absolute luxury. She was, after all, designed for royalty. Launched in 1996, she presents in absolutely pristine condition, thanks to the meticulous care of her current owner and crew, who have lovingly maintained her – with no expense spared - every Spring and Autumn since 2000.

She represents a fantastic opportunity to acquire an exceptionally well-maintained Feadship with a rich character and history. Capable of accommodating up to 16 guests across 8 generously sized cabins, she delivers both comfort and luxury within each of the guest cabins and staterooms. Guest accommodation has been carefully considered, with cabins available in different sizes, from single cabins to a grand VIP stateroom, a unique feature of hers.

The Master Suite includes a private lounge and office, an exercise room, a dining room and a lounge. Located on the bridge deck, the VIP suite was originally designed to accommodate the Sultan of Brunei, who never came onboard and was therefore never used until 2000. The port and starboard side double cabins have en suites with bath and shower along with his and her sinks. Can also be converted to a twin cabin, if required. Port and starboard side twin cabins have en suites with bath and shower. Port & starboard single cabins have en suites along with charming desk areas.

Her spacious interior, designed by London’s Winch Design, is splendidly classic with soothing light natural woods complemented by gold detailing along with cream and beige soft furnishings.

On the main deck, the voluminous main salon and dining area, office and exercise room sit adjacent to the spectacular owner’s stateroom, with its private forward lounge, walk-in wardrobe and spectacular bathroom, and can be used as an unofficial owner’s deck if required.

An ornate guest elevator and central staircase leads to the bridge deck, where a similarly sized – and equally luxurious – VIP stateroom can be found, along with a second salon with grand piano. The well-thought-out layout includes separate entrances and staircases for crew throughout the yacht to ensure discreet service.

Entertaining on a yacht has never been so easy thanks to the variety of outdoor areas she boasts. The sun deck is the outdoor area of choice, with a Jacuzzi perfectly placed near the incredibly ornate bar along with four other seating areas for soaking up the sun. Other outdoor areas include the bridge deck aft and main deck aft, both ideal for sundowners with friends or quiet family meals.

Under the direction of diligent owners, she has been impeccably and regularly maintained by the crew. With routine maintenance being consistently carried out every Spring and Autumn since 2000. She completed a significant yard period / refit at Monaco Marine in La Ciotat 2023.

ACCOMMODATIONS

 

OVERVIEW 
Delightfully generous layout plan with master stateroom on deck forward with private observation salon and lounge, owner’s bathroom with two sinks, his and her WC, one with a bidet, central steam shower and large tub. Walk in wardrobe, beauty, hair and massage room as well as an owner’s office and a private owner’s staircase down to the guest stateroom deck. VIP or second master stateroom on bridge deck with bathroom with bathtub and shower and access to the VIP and bridge deck salon. Four large guest suites with en suite bathrooms with tubs and separate showers below deck, and two single staff cabins between the four guest suites, each with bathroom with shower.
 
ACCOMMODATIONS
Guest Accommodations

  1 x Twin stateroom with 85cm x 198cm bed(port) with en suite bathroom with shower over bath, single washbasin, bidet and WC
  1 x Twin stateroom with 85cm x 198cm bed (starboard) with en suite bathroom with separate shower stall, washbasin, bidet and WC

  1 x Twin security cabin (in aft lazarette, portside) with 2 single upper and lower berths, and shower room with sink and WC en suite
  2 x 3 Berth crew cabins each with shower rooms en suite
  3 x Twin crew cabins each with shower rooms en suite
   
TANK DECK:  Freezer room forward to port with laundry opposite to starboard. Fridge room aft of freezer with dry store opposite. Food lift on centerline and main dry storeroom further aft.
 
LOWER DECK AND CREW ACCOMODATIONS: 2 x triple crew cabins with heads with dry showers all the way forward. Port and starboard twin crew cabins with bathrooms with dry showers further aft. Another two-berth crew cabin with bathroom further aft to starboard ahead of the engineer’s cabin with double berth and bathroom. Generous crew mess to port. Four guest and two staff staterooms further aft with elevator and foyer/staircase access. Engine room and ECR further aft with separate well insulated generator room housing 3 x Caterpillar generators to starboard. Security or additional crew cabin aft to starboard with dry shower, WC and sink. Large lazarette with generous swim platform access.
 
MAIN DECK: Owner’s observation lounge is forward with settee seating to port and game table to starboard. Nice views forward. Owner’s stateroom with Caesar king bed is further aft with bathroom aft to port (see earlier), walk in wardrobe, gym/massage room and owner’s office. Day head adjacent main deck lobby, with elevator and central staircase centreline, main galley and pantry opposite to port. Dining room for 16 people around an oval table, with main salon further aft.  The main deck aft is also a very generous size with dining table for 16 people and U-shaped seating all the way aft between port and starboard staircases down to the swim platform.
 
BRIDGE DECK:  The bridge is forward with wrap around seating for 6 people either side of the chart table. Captain’s cabin with island double berth, settee, desk and bathroom en suite. Radio room to starboard with dual workstations, pantry/flower pantry aft, day head further aft beside the elevator and staircase and access to the VIP or second master adjacent the elevator. VIP stateroom is almost full beam with corridor access aft on the starboard side to the full beam sky lounge or VIP lounge. The VIP aft deck outside has been modified to have wrap around seating around a dining table for 10 on starboard side and sun lounger seating to port.
 
SUN DECK:  One of the most efficient sundecks seen on a yacht this size. Two circular sun pads port and starboard sides forward. Storage lockers for cushions. Elevator and main staircase come out in the fully furnished “stack” and there is also a day head with shower with inside and outside access on the port side of the “funnel”. Outside at the aft end of the funnel is a U-shaped bar with stools, just ahead of a large hot tub. Port and starboard sides have U-shaped seating around coffee tables and the two deck cranes for the tenders store flush behind those settees so as to keep the deck clear for helicopter ops if desired. There are 3 steps down to the helicopter landing deck where the two tenders and wave runners are also stored.

Refit 2024/2025
all work done at Royal Van Lent Shipyard, Amsterdam
Poised for adventure with a fresh new look and enhanced performance, Olympus has undergone an extensive refit for 2024/2025, combining elevated guest comfort with cutting-edge operational upgrades.
 
Interior Elegance
From the guest cabins to the galley, every detail has been thoughtfully refined to reflect comfort, functionality, and timeless sophistication. Newly reupholstered guest chairs complement the yacht’s aesthetic, while meticulous carpentry touch-ups continue to elevate the interior ambiance. Guest carpets and exterior cushions have been professionally deep-cleaned and restored, delivering a fresh, revitalized atmosphere throughout.
 
Luxurious touches such as gold-polished and replated door handles and updated Roman blinds—replaced in the master and lower guest cabins—further enhance the refined environment.
 
In the galley, a brand-new professional grade cooking range, including ovens, fryers, and hobs, ensures seamless culinary service. Updated dry store shelving has transformed storage efficiency, while new flooring creates a modern, cohesive flow between the galley and crew areas. Additional improvements include upgraded guest toilet accessories and a fully restored walk-in fridge and freezer system, both performing at peak reliability.
 
Deck Enhancements
On deck, Olympus has received a full exterior refresh. All cushions and covers have been replaced, tables and bars re-varnished and wrapped, and the Jacuzzi completely overhauled. Re-hung and adjusted exterior doors now operate with precision, and striking stainless steel, backlit Olympus nameboards have been added to both sides of the vessel—amplifying her visual presence.
 
Bridge & Navigational Upgrades
A comprehensive bridge refit has brought Olympus in line with modern navigational standards. The console has been re-engineered with a sleek new leather finish, and a full suite of advanced navigation equipment has been installed. All navigation lights were upgraded to energy-efficient LED systems, and both depth sounders were modernized to improve redundancy and safety.
 
Mechanical & Technical Systems
A major overhaul of onboard systems focused on performance and reliability. This includes a fully new HVAC system, with two new air handling units and 20 new fan coil units to ensure superior climate control. The power management and alarm monitoring systems were upgraded to a state-of-the-art Praxis setup. Additionally, fuel tank level sensors were modernized, and a new variable speed drive was installed for the bow thruster.
 
Operational Efficiency
Operational improvements include the complete overhaul and repainting of all three onboard cranes, which were removed and reinstalled for optimal performance. The anchor windlass electrical systems were upgraded, and new dual anchor shackles were fitted to enhance deep anchoring capabilities. Below deck, the lazarette has been redesigned for improved layout and functionality, supporting a more efficient crew operation and ultimately enriching the guest experience.

OLYMPUS is in many ways, the archetypal Feadship. She has the superior build quality and technical capabilities to take her all over the world. The sleek, well-designed exterior to turn heads in any port. And the space and versatility to accommodate any kind of group in absolute luxury. She was, after all, designed for royalty. Launched in 1996, she presents in absolutely pristine condition, thanks to the meticulous care of her current owner and crew, who have lovingly maintained her – with no expense spared - every Spring and Autumn since 2000.

She represents a fantastic opportunity to acquire an exceptionally well-maintained Feadship with a rich character and history. Capable of accommodating up to 16 guests across 8 generously sized cabins, she delivers both comfort and luxury within each of the guest cabins and staterooms. Guest accommodation has been carefully considered, with cabins available in different sizes, from single cabins to a grand VIP stateroom, a unique feature of hers.

The Master Suite includes a private lounge and office, an exercise room, a dining room and a lounge. Located on the bridge deck, the VIP suite was originally designed to accommodate the Sultan of Brunei, who never came onboard and was therefore never used until 2000. The port and starboard side double cabins have en suites with bath and shower along with his and her sinks. Can also be converted to a twin cabin, if required. Port and starboard side twin cabins have en suites with bath and shower. Port & starboard single cabins have en suites along with charming desk areas.

Her spacious interior, designed by London’s Winch Design, is splendidly classic with soothing light natural woods complemented by gold detailing along with cream and beige soft furnishings.

On the main deck, the voluminous main salon and dining area, office and exercise room sit adjacent to the spectacular owner’s stateroom, with its private forward lounge, walk-in wardrobe and spectacular bathroom, and can be used as an unofficial owner’s deck if required.

An ornate guest elevator and central staircase leads to the bridge deck, where a similarly sized – and equally luxurious – VIP stateroom can be found, along with a second salon with grand piano. The well-thought-out layout includes separate entrances and staircases for crew throughout the yacht to ensure discreet service.

Entertaining on a yacht has never been so easy thanks to the variety of outdoor areas she boasts. The sun deck is the outdoor area of choice, with a Jacuzzi perfectly placed near the incredibly ornate bar along with four other seating areas for soaking up the sun. Other outdoor areas include the bridge deck aft and main deck aft, both ideal for sundowners with friends or quiet family meals.

Under the direction of diligent owners, she has been impeccably and regularly maintained by the crew. With routine maintenance being consistently carried out every Spring and Autumn since 2000. She completed a significant yard period / refit at Monaco Marine in La Ciotat 2023.

ACCOMMODATIONS

 

OVERVIEW 
Delightfully generous layout plan with master stateroom on deck forward with private observation salon and lounge, owner’s bathroom with two sinks, his and her WC, one with a bidet, central steam shower and large tub. Walk in wardrobe, beauty, hair and massage room as well as an owner’s office and a private owner’s staircase down to the guest stateroom deck. VIP or second master stateroom on bridge deck with bathroom with bathtub and shower and access to the VIP and bridge deck salon. Four large guest suites with en suite bathrooms with tubs and separate showers below deck, and two single staff cabins between the four guest suites, each with bathroom with shower.
 
ACCOMMODATIONS
Guest Accommodations
Owners Stateroom and separate forward-facing sitting area which can be opened up or closed off from sleeping area. Large marble bathroom and en suite with whirlpool bath, 2 x washbasins, \"his and hers\" WC compartments, one with a bidet and large stall shower

  1 x Twin stateroom with 85cm x 198cm bed (starboard) with en suite bathroom with separate shower stall, washbasin, bidet and WC

  1 x Single 3/4 sized engineer's cabin (with extending single berth) with shower room en suite, and alarm panel
  1 x Twin security cabin (in aft lazarette, portside) with 2 single upper and lower berths, and shower room with sink and WC en suite
  2 x 3 Berth crew cabins each with shower rooms en suite
  3 x Twin crew cabins each with shower rooms en suite
   
TANK DECK:  Freezer room forward to port with laundry opposite to starboard. Fridge room aft of freezer with dry store opposite. Food lift on centerline and main dry storeroom further aft.
 
LOWER DECK AND CREW ACCOMODATIONS: 2 x triple crew cabins with heads with dry showers all the way forward. Port and starboard twin crew cabins with bathrooms with dry showers further aft. Another two-berth crew cabin with bathroom further aft to starboard ahead of the engineer’s cabin with double berth and bathroom. Generous crew mess to port. Four guest and two staff staterooms further aft with elevator and foyer/staircase access. Engine room and ECR further aft with separate well insulated generator room housing 3 x Caterpillar generators to starboard. Security or additional crew cabin aft to starboard with dry shower, WC and sink. Large lazarette with generous swim platform access.
 
MAIN DECK: Owner’s observation lounge is forward with settee seating to port and game table to starboard. Nice views forward. Owner’s stateroom with Caesar king bed is further aft with bathroom aft to port (see earlier), walk in wardrobe, gym/massage room and owner’s office. Day head adjacent main deck lobby, with elevator and central staircase centreline, main galley and pantry opposite to port. Dining room for 16 people around an oval table, with main salon further aft.  The main deck aft is also a very generous size with dining table for 16 people and U-shaped seating all the way aft between port and starboard staircases down to the swim platform.
 
BRIDGE DECK:  The bridge is forward with wrap around seating for 6 people either side of the chart table. Captain’s cabin with island double berth, settee, desk and bathroom en suite. Radio room to starboard with dual workstations, pantry/flower pantry aft, day head further aft beside the elevator and staircase and access to the VIP or second master adjacent the elevator. VIP stateroom is almost full beam with corridor access aft on the starboard side to the full beam sky lounge or VIP lounge. The VIP aft deck outside has been modified to have wrap around seating around a dining table for 10 on starboard side and sun lounger seating to port.
 
SUN DECK:  One of the most efficient sundecks seen on a yacht this size. Two circular sun pads port and starboard sides forward. Storage lockers for cushions. Elevator and main staircase come out in the fully furnished “stack” and there is also a day head with shower with inside and outside access on the port side of the “funnel”. Outside at the aft end of the funnel is a U-shaped bar with stools, just ahead of a large hot tub. Port and starboard sides have U-shaped seating around coffee tables and the two deck cranes for the tenders store flush behind those settees so as to keep the deck clear for helicopter ops if desired. There are 3 steps down to the helicopter landing deck where the two tenders and wave runners are also stored.

Refit 2024/2025
all work done at Royal Van Lent Shipyard, Amsterdam
Poised for adventure with a fresh new look and enhanced performance, Olympus has undergone an extensive refit for 2024/2025, combining elevated guest comfort with cutting-edge operational upgrades.
 
Interior Elegance
From the guest cabins to the galley, every detail has been thoughtfully refined to reflect comfort, functionality, and timeless sophistication. Newly reupholstered guest chairs complement the yacht’s aesthetic, while meticulous carpentry touch-ups continue to elevate the interior ambiance. Guest carpets and exterior cushions have been professionally deep-cleaned and restored, delivering a fresh, revitalized atmosphere throughout.
 
Luxurious touches such as gold-polished and replated door handles and updated Roman blinds—replaced in the master and lower guest cabins—further enhance the refined environment.
 
In the galley, a brand-new professional grade cooking range, including ovens, fryers, and hobs, ensures seamless culinary service. Updated dry store shelving has transformed storage efficiency, while new flooring creates a modern, cohesive flow between the galley and crew areas. Additional improvements include upgraded guest toilet accessories and a fully restored walk-in fridge and freezer system, both performing at peak reliability.
 
Deck Enhancements
On deck, Olympus has received a full exterior refresh. All cushions and covers have been replaced, tables and bars re-varnished and wrapped, and the Jacuzzi completely overhauled. Re-hung and adjusted exterior doors now operate with precision, and striking stainless steel, backlit Olympus nameboards have been added to both sides of the vessel—amplifying her visual presence.
 
Bridge & Navigational Upgrades
A comprehensive bridge refit has brought Olympus in line with modern navigational standards. The console has been re-engineered with a sleek new leather finish, and a full suite of advanced navigation equipment has been installed. All navigation lights were upgraded to energy-efficient LED systems, and both depth sounders were modernized to improve redundancy and safety.
 
Mechanical & Technical Systems
A major overhaul of onboard systems focused on performance and reliability. This includes a fully new HVAC system, with two new air handling units and 20 new fan coil units to ensure superior climate control. The power management and alarm monitoring systems were upgraded to a state-of-the-art Praxis setup. Additionally, fuel tank level sensors were modernized, and a new variable speed drive was installed for the bow thruster.
 
Operational Efficiency
Operational improvements include the complete overhaul and repainting of all three onboard cranes, which were removed and reinstalled for optimal performance. The anchor windlass electrical systems were upgraded, and new dual anchor shackles were fitted to enhance deep anchoring capabilities. Below deck, the lazarette has been redesigned for improved layout and functionality, supporting a more efficient crew operation and ultimately enriching the guest experience.

{"Beam": 10, "City": "", "Open": false, "Year": 1996, "tags": [], "MLSID": 406680, "Length": 55, "Sleeps": 16, "EventID": 0, "IsModel": false, "LOAFeet": 180.44, "details": {"VD": {"VesselID": 406680, "CultureID": 1, "DataSource": 1, "VesselName": "Olympus", "CultureName": "English", "ExternalLink": "https://www.yachtolympus.com/", "CultureShortName": "EN", "Loading_ShortDescription": false, "Loading_MyWebSiteDescription": false, "VesselDescriptionBrokerTeaser": "", "Loading_YatcoDotComDescription": false, "VesselDescriptionInternalTeaser": "", "VesselDescriptionShortDescription": "

OLYMPUS is in many ways, the archetypal Feadship. She has the superior build quality and technical capabilities to take her all over the world. The sleek, well-designed exterior to turn heads in any port. And the space and versatility to accommodate any kind of group in absolute luxury. She was, after all, designed for royalty. Launched in 1996, she presents in absolutely pristine condition, thanks to the meticulous care of her current owner and crew, who have lovingly maintained her – with no expense spared - every Spring and Autumn since 2000.

She represents a fantastic opportunity to acquire an exceptionally well-maintained Feadship with a rich character and history. Capable of accommodating up to 16 guests across 8 generously sized cabins, she delivers both comfort and luxury within each of the guest cabins and staterooms. Guest accommodation has been carefully considered, with cabins available in different sizes, from single cabins to a grand VIP stateroom, a unique feature of hers.

The Master Suite includes a private lounge and office, an exercise room, a dining room and a lounge. Located on the bridge deck, the VIP suite was originally designed to accommodate the Sultan of Brunei, who never came onboard and was therefore never used until 2000. The port and starboard side double cabins have en suites with bath and shower along with his and her sinks. Can also be converted to a twin cabin, if required. Port and starboard side twin cabins have en suites with bath and shower. Port & starboard single cabins have en suites along with charming desk areas.

Her spacious interior, designed by London’s Winch Design, is splendidly classic with soothing light natural woods complemented by gold detailing along with cream and beige soft furnishings.

On the main deck, the voluminous main salon and dining area, office and exercise room sit adjacent to the spectacular owner’s stateroom, with its private forward lounge, walk-in wardrobe and spectacular bathroom, and can be used as an unofficial owner’s deck if required.

An ornate guest elevator and central staircase leads to the bridge deck, where a similarly sized – and equally luxurious – VIP stateroom can be found, along with a second salon with grand piano. The well-thought-out layout includes separate entrances and staircases for crew throughout the yacht to ensure discreet service.

Entertaining on a yacht has never been so easy thanks to the variety of outdoor areas she boasts. The sun deck is the outdoor area of choice, with a Jacuzzi perfectly placed near the incredibly ornate bar along with four other seating areas for soaking up the sun. Other outdoor areas include the bridge deck aft and main deck aft, both ideal for sundowners with friends or quiet family meals.

Under the direction of diligent owners, she has been impeccably and regularly maintained by the crew. With routine maintenance being consistently carried out every Spring and Autumn since 2000. She completed a significant yard period / refit at Monaco Marine in La Ciotat 2023.

false, "VesselDescriptionShortDescription": "

OLYMPUS is in many ways, the archetypal Feadship. She has the superior build quality and technical capabilities to take her all over the world. The sleek, well-designed exterior to turn heads in any port. And the space and versatility to accommodate any kind of group in absolute luxury. She was, after all, designed for royalty. Launched in 1996, she presents in absolutely pristine condition, thanks to the meticulous care of her current owner and crew, who have lovingly maintained her – with no expense spared - every Spring and Autumn since 2000.

She represents a fantastic opportunity to acquire an exceptionally well-maintained Feadship with a rich character and history. Capable of accommodating up to 16 guests across 8 generously sized cabins, she delivers both comfort and luxury within each of the guest cabins and staterooms. Guest accommodation has been carefully considered, with cabins available in different sizes, from single cabins to a grand VIP stateroom, a unique feature of hers.

The Master Suite includes a private lounge and office, an exercise room, a dining room and a lounge. Located on the bridge deck, the VIP suite was originally designed to accommodate the Sultan of Brunei, who never came onboard and was therefore never used until 2000. The port and starboard side double cabins have en suites with bath and shower along with his and her sinks. Can also be converted to a twin cabin, if required. Port and starboard side twin cabins have en suites with bath and shower. Port & starboard single cabins have en suites along with charming desk areas.

Her spacious interior, designed by London’s Winch Design, is splendidly classic with soothing light natural woods complemented by gold detailing along with cream and beige soft furnishings.

On the main deck, the voluminous main salon and dining area, office and exercise room sit adjacent to the spectacular owner’s stateroom, with its private forward lounge, walk-in wardrobe and spectacular bathroom, and can be used as an unofficial owner’s deck if required.

An ornate guest elevator and central staircase leads to the bridge deck, where a similarly sized – and equally luxurious – VIP stateroom can be found, along with a second salon with grand piano. The well-thought-out layout includes separate entrances and staircases for crew throughout the yacht to ensure discreet service.

Entertaining on a yacht has never been so easy thanks to the variety of outdoor areas she boasts. The sun deck is the outdoor area of choice, with a Jacuzzi perfectly placed near the incredibly ornate bar along with four other seating areas for soaking up the sun. Other outdoor areas include the bridge deck aft and main deck aft, both ideal for sundowners with friends or quiet family meals.

Under the direction of diligent owners, she has been impeccably and regularly maintained by the crew. With routine maintenance being consistently carried out every Spring and Autumn since 2000. She completed a significant yard period / refit at Monaco Marine in La Ciotat 2023.

She was built as project # 649 at the De Vries Shipyard to a De Voogt design and delivered as MY WHITE RABBIT in 1995. This steel hull, full displacement motor yacht has and rich and elegant interior by Winch Design using bold mahogany panelling whilst incorporating some lighter panels and pieces of furniture including a white piano in the sky lounge. Both the main salon and sky lounge are flooded with natural day light due to the large floor to ceiling windows. In 2009 she returned to Feadship for an extensive refit including a 4-metre aft extension that allowed for a beach club to be built in. The sun deck was also extended, which now makes for a superb exterior entertaining area.

 

MY PEGASUS offers a tremendous volume of 679 GT, impressive for a yacht of her size. She has a particularly large full-beam Owner’s suite on the main deck with his and hers bathrooms as well as a private Owner’s office. A formal circular dining room is on the main deck, separated from the main salon by a sweeping staircase incorporating a sky light running through the interior. There are another five guest suites below deck that have direct access to the beach club at the aft end of the passageway.

 

Whilst an inspection is recommended, some of her main features are summarised below:

 

  • Steel hull and aluminium superstructure designed by De Voogt Naval Architects and built by De Vries. A true pedigree Feadship.
  • 3,900 nautical mile range at 11.5 knots.
  • A comfortable and voluminous interior by Winch Design, offering a full beam Owner’s suite and a further five guest cabins below deck (12 guests in 6 staterooms)
  • Extensive and well-appointed deck areas - Vast sundeck with dedicated spa area and Jacuzzi Forward. Bridge deck aft with large, shaded dining for 14 guests. Comfortable shaded aft deck, with dining table as well as relaxed seating aft with custom made screens for privacy or shelter on a windy day
  • Easy access to the water via Med stars and the large folding swim platform and beach club.
  • Maintained and upgraded to the highest standards by a passionate owner and dedicated crew

 

Refit:

MY PEGASUS underwent a major refit at Feadship in 2009; including the aft 4 metre extension that also incorporates the beach club. The sundeck was extended, and a variety of technical and aesthetic works were carried out which included a full repaint, top to bottom. She is Lloyds Register Class and commercially registered. In 2023 she underwent another technical refit which included the installation of two new Caterpillar generators, an overhauling of the main engines and servicing of the main bearings, seals and control of the tail shafts, as well as servicing of other main equipment and machinery.

The sun deck was also extended, which now makes for a superb exterior entertaining area.

 

MY PEGASUS offers a tremendous volume of 679 GT, impressive for a yacht of her size. She has a particularly large full-beam Owner’s suite on the main deck with his and hers bathrooms as well as a private Owner’s office. A formal circular dining room is on the main deck, separated from the main salon by a sweeping staircase incorporating a sky light running through the interior. There are another five guest suites below deck that have direct access to the beach club at the aft end of the passageway.

 

Whilst an inspection is recommended, some of her main features are summarised below:

 

  • Steel hull and aluminium superstructure designed by De Voogt Naval Architects and built by De Vries. A true pedigree Feadship.
  • 3,900 nautical mile range at 11.5 knots.
  • A comfortable and voluminous interior by Winch Design, offering a full beam Owner’s suite and a further five guest cabins below deck (12 guests in 6 staterooms)
  • Extensive and well-appointed deck areas - Vast sundeck with dedicated spa area and Jacuzzi Forward. Bridge deck aft with large, shaded dining for 14 guests. Comfortable shaded aft deck, with dining table as well as relaxed seating aft with custom made screens for privacy or shelter on a windy day
  • Easy access to the water via Med stars and the large folding swim platform and beach club.
  • Maintained and upgraded to the highest standards by a passionate owner and dedicated crew

 

Refit:

MY PEGASUS underwent a major refit at Feadship in 2009; including the aft 4 metre extension that also incorporates the beach club. The sundeck was extended, and a variety of technical and aesthetic works were carried out which included a full repaint, top to bottom. She is Lloyds Register Class and commercially registered. In 2023 she underwent another technical refit which included the installation of two new Caterpillar generators, an overhauling of the main engines and servicing of the main bearings, seals and control of the tail shafts, as well as servicing of other main equipment and machinery.

She was built as project # 649 at the De Vries Shipyard to a De Voogt design and delivered as MY WHITE RABBIT in 1995. This steel hull, full displacement motor yacht has and rich and elegant interior by Winch Design using bold mahogany panelling whilst incorporating some lighter panels and pieces of furniture including a white piano in the sky lounge. Both the main salon and sky lounge are flooded with natural day light due to the large floor to ceiling windows. In 2009 she returned to Feadship for an extensive refit including a 4-metre aft extension that allowed for a beach club to be built in. The sun deck was also extended, which now makes for a superb exterior entertaining area.

 

MY PEGASUS offers a tremendous volume of 679 GT, impressive for a yacht of her size. She has a particularly large full-beam Owner’s suite on the main deck with his and hers bathrooms as well as a private Owner’s office. A formal circular dining room is on the main deck, separated from the main salon by a sweeping staircase incorporating a sky light running through the interior. There are another five guest suites below deck that have direct access to the beach club at the aft end of the passageway.

 

Whilst an inspection is recommended, some of her main features are summarised below:

 

  • Steel hull and aluminium superstructure designed by De Voogt Naval Architects and built by De Vries. A true pedigree Feadship.
  • 3,900 nautical mile range at 11.5 knots.
  • A comfortable and voluminous interior by Winch Design, offering a full beam Owner’s suite and a further five guest cabins below deck (12 guests in 6 staterooms)
  • Extensive and well-appointed deck areas - Vast sundeck with dedicated spa area and Jacuzzi Forward. Bridge deck aft with large, shaded dining for 14 guests. Comfortable shaded aft deck, with dining table as well as relaxed seating aft with custom made screens for privacy or shelter on a windy day
  • Easy access to the water via Med stars and the large folding swim platform and beach club.
  • Maintained and upgraded to the highest standards by a passionate owner and dedicated crew

 

Refit:

MY PEGASUS underwent a major refit at Feadship in 2009; including the aft 4 metre extension that also incorporates the beach club. The sundeck was extended, and a variety of technical and aesthetic works were carried out which included a full repaint, top to bottom. She is Lloyds Register Class and commercially registered. In 2023 she underwent another technical refit which included the installation of two new Caterpillar generators, an overhauling of the main engines and servicing of the main bearings, seals and control of the tail shafts, as well as servicing of other main equipment and machinery.

"VesselDescriptionShortDescription": "

She was built as project # 649 at the De Vries Shipyard to a De Voogt design and delivered as MY WHITE RABBIT in 1995. This steel hull, full displacement motor yacht has and rich and elegant interior by Winch Design using bold mahogany panelling whilst incorporating some lighter panels and pieces of furniture including a white piano in the sky lounge. Both the main salon and sky lounge are flooded with natural day light due to the large floor to ceiling windows. In 2009 she returned to Feadship for an extensive refit including a 4-metre aft extension that allowed for a beach club to be built in. The sun deck was also extended, which now makes for a superb exterior entertaining area.

 

MY PEGASUS offers a tremendous volume of 679 GT, impressive for a yacht of her size. She has a particularly large full-beam Owner’s suite on the main deck with his and hers bathrooms as well as a private Owner’s office. A formal circular dining room is on the main deck, separated from the main salon by a sweeping staircase incorporating a sky light running through the interior. There are another five guest suites below deck that have direct access to the beach club at the aft end of the passageway.

 

Whilst an inspection is recommended, some of her main features are summarised below:

 

  • Steel hull and aluminium superstructure designed by De Voogt Naval Architects and built by De Vries. A true pedigree Feadship.
  • 3,900 nautical mile range at 11.5 knots.
  • A comfortable and voluminous interior by Winch Design, offering a full beam Owner’s suite and a further five guest cabins below deck (12 guests in 6 staterooms)
  • Extensive and well-appointed deck areas - Vast sundeck with dedicated spa area and Jacuzzi Forward. Bridge deck aft with large, shaded dining for 14 guests. Comfortable shaded aft deck, with dining table as well as relaxed seating aft with custom made screens for privacy or shelter on a windy day
  • Easy access to the water via Med stars and the large folding swim platform and beach club.
  • Maintained and upgraded to the highest standards by a passionate owner and dedicated crew

 

Refit:

MY PEGASUS underwent a major refit at Feadship in 2009; including the aft 4 metre extension that also incorporates the beach club. The sundeck was extended, and a variety of technical and aesthetic works were carried out which included a full repaint, top to bottom. She is Lloyds Register Class and commercially registered. In 2023 she underwent another technical refit which included the installation of two new Caterpillar generators, an overhauling of the main engines and servicing of the main bearings, seals and control of the tail shafts, as well as servicing of other main equipment and machinery.

She was built as project # 649 at the De Vries Shipyard to a De Voogt design and delivered as MY WHITE RABBIT in 1995. This steel hull, full displacement motor yacht has and rich and elegant interior by Winch Design using bold mahogany panelling whilst incorporating some lighter panels and pieces of furniture including a white piano in the sky lounge. Both the main salon and sky lounge are flooded with natural day light due to the large floor to ceiling windows. In 2009 she returned to Feadship for an extensive refit including a 4-metre aft extension that allowed for a beach club to be built in. The sun deck was also extended, which now makes for a superb exterior entertaining area.

 

MY PEGASUS offers a tremendous volume of 679 GT, impressive for a yacht of her size. She has a particularly large full-beam Owner’s suite on the main deck with his and hers bathrooms as well as a private Owner’s office. A formal circular dining room is on the main deck, separated from the main salon by a sweeping staircase incorporating a sky light running through the interior. There are another five guest suites below deck that have direct access to the beach club at the aft end of the passageway.

 

Whilst an inspection is recommended, some of her main features are summarised below:

 

  • Steel hull and aluminium superstructure designed by De Voogt Naval Architects and built by De Vries. A true pedigree Feadship.
  • 3,900 nautical mile range at 11.5 knots.
  • A comfortable and voluminous interior by Winch Design, offering a full beam Owner’s suite and a further five guest cabins below deck (12 guests in 6 staterooms)
  • Extensive and well-appointed deck areas - Vast sundeck with dedicated spa area and Jacuzzi Forward. Bridge deck aft with large, shaded dining for 14 guests. Comfortable shaded aft deck, with dining table as well as relaxed seating aft with custom made screens for privacy or shelter on a windy day
  • Easy access to the water via Med stars and the large folding swim platform and beach club.
  • Maintained and upgraded to the highest standards by a passionate owner and dedicated crew

 

Refit:

MY PEGASUS underwent a major refit at Feadship in 2009; including the aft 4 metre extension that also incorporates the beach club. The sundeck was extended, and a variety of technical and aesthetic works were carried out which included a full repaint, top to bottom. She is Lloyds Register Class and commercially registered. In 2023 she underwent another technical refit which included the installation of two new Caterpillar generators, an overhauling of the main engines and servicing of the main bearings, seals and control of the tail shafts, as well as servicing of other main equipment and machinery.

There are another five guest suites below deck that have direct access to the beach club at the aft end of the passageway.

 

Whilst an inspection is recommended, some of her main features are summarised below:

 

  • Steel hull and aluminium superstructure designed by De Voogt Naval Architects and built by De Vries. A true pedigree Feadship.
  • 3,900 nautical mile range at 11.5 knots.
  • A comfortable and voluminous interior by Winch Design, offering a full beam Owner’s suite and a further five guest cabins below deck (12 guests in 6 staterooms)
  • Extensive and well-appointed deck areas - Vast sundeck with dedicated spa area and Jacuzzi Forward. Bridge deck aft with large, shaded dining for 14 guests. Comfortable shaded aft deck, with dining table as well as relaxed seating aft with custom made screens for privacy or shelter on a windy day
  • Easy access to the water via Med stars and the large folding swim platform and beach club.
  • Maintained and upgraded to the highest standards by a passionate owner and dedicated crew

 

Refit:

MY PEGASUS underwent a major refit at Feadship in 2009; including the aft 4 metre extension that also incorporates the beach club. The sundeck was extended, and a variety of technical and aesthetic works were carried out which included a full repaint, top to bottom. She is Lloyds Register Class and commercially registered. In 2023 she underwent another technical refit which included the installation of two new Caterpillar generators, an overhauling of the main engines and servicing of the main bearings, seals and control of the tail shafts, as well as servicing of other main equipment and machinery.

She was built as project # 649 at the De Vries Shipyard to a De Voogt design and delivered as MY WHITE RABBIT in 1995. This steel hull, full displacement motor yacht has and rich and elegant interior by Winch Design using bold mahogany panelling whilst incorporating some lighter panels and pieces of furniture including a white piano in the sky lounge. Both the main salon and sky lounge are flooded with natural day light due to the large floor to ceiling windows. In 2009 she returned to Feadship for an extensive refit including a 4-metre aft extension that allowed for a beach club to be built in. The sun deck was also extended, which now makes for a superb exterior entertaining area.

 

MY PEGASUS offers a tremendous volume of 679 GT, impressive for a yacht of her size. She has a particularly large full-beam Owner’s suite on the main deck with his and hers bathrooms as well as a private Owner’s office. A formal circular dining room is on the main deck, separated from the main salon by a sweeping staircase incorporating a sky light running through the interior. There are another five guest suites below deck that have direct access to the beach club at the aft end of the passageway.

 

Whilst an inspection is recommended, some of her main features are summarised below:

 

  • Steel hull and aluminium superstructure designed by De Voogt Naval Architects and built by De Vries. A true pedigree Feadship.
  • 3,900 nautical mile range at 11.5 knots.
  • A comfortable and voluminous interior by Winch Design, offering a full beam Owner’s suite and a further five guest cabins below deck (12 guests in 6 staterooms)
  • Extensive and well-appointed deck areas - Vast sundeck with dedicated spa area and Jacuzzi Forward. Bridge deck aft with large, shaded dining for 14 guests. Comfortable shaded aft deck, with dining table as well as relaxed seating aft with custom made screens for privacy or shelter on a windy day
  • Easy access to the water via Med stars and the large folding swim platform and beach club.
  • Maintained and upgraded to the highest standards by a passionate owner and dedicated crew

 

Refit:

MY PEGASUS underwent a major refit at Feadship in 2009; including the aft 4 metre extension that also incorporates the beach club. The sundeck was extended, and a variety of technical and aesthetic works were carried out which included a full repaint, top to bottom. She is Lloyds Register Class and commercially registered. In 2023 she underwent another technical refit which included the installation of two new Caterpillar generators, an overhauling of the main engines and servicing of the main bearings, seals and control of the tail shafts, as well as servicing of other main equipment and machinery.

"VesselDescriptionShortDescription": "

She was built as project # 649 at the De Vries Shipyard to a De Voogt design and delivered as MY WHITE RABBIT in 1995. This steel hull, full displacement motor yacht has and rich and elegant interior by Winch Design using bold mahogany panelling whilst incorporating some lighter panels and pieces of furniture including a white piano in the sky lounge. Both the main salon and sky lounge are flooded with natural day light due to the large floor to ceiling windows. In 2009 she returned to Feadship for an extensive refit including a 4-metre aft extension that allowed for a beach club to be built in. The sun deck was also extended, which now makes for a superb exterior entertaining area.

 

MY PEGASUS offers a tremendous volume of 679 GT, impressive for a yacht of her size. She has a particularly large full-beam Owner’s suite on the main deck with his and hers bathrooms as well as a private Owner’s office. A formal circular dining room is on the main deck, separated from the main salon by a sweeping staircase incorporating a sky light running through the interior. There are another five guest suites below deck that have direct access to the beach club at the aft end of the passageway.

 

Whilst an inspection is recommended, some of her main features are summarised below:

 

  • Steel hull and aluminium superstructure designed by De Voogt Naval Architects and built by De Vries. A true pedigree Feadship.
  • 3,900 nautical mile range at 11.5 knots.
  • A comfortable and voluminous interior by Winch Design, offering a full beam Owner’s suite and a further five guest cabins below deck (12 guests in 6 staterooms)
  • Extensive and well-appointed deck areas - Vast sundeck with dedicated spa area and Jacuzzi Forward. Bridge deck aft with large, shaded dining for 14 guests. Comfortable shaded aft deck, with dining table as well as relaxed seating aft with custom made screens for privacy or shelter on a windy day
  • Easy access to the water via Med stars and the large folding swim platform and beach club.
  • Maintained and upgraded to the highest standards by a passionate owner and dedicated crew

 

Refit:

MY PEGASUS underwent a major refit at Feadship in 2009; including the aft 4 metre extension that also incorporates the beach club. The sundeck was extended, and a variety of technical and aesthetic works were carried out which included a full repaint, top to bottom. She is Lloyds Register Class and commercially registered. In 2023 she underwent another technical refit which included the installation of two new Caterpillar generators, an overhauling of the main engines and servicing of the main bearings, seals and control of the tail shafts, as well as servicing of other main equipment and machinery.

The lovely Tatasu was righty seen as representing the cutting edge of contemporary design when launched in 1994 and remains a stunning classic today. Tatasu then arrived at Feadship Makkum for activities which included a complete engine room rebuild with new main engines, new generators, a new switchboard, the very latest alarm & monitoring system and the construction of an air-conditioned control room, which the original design had lacked. While these inside technical activities were going on the renowned paint team at Feadship gave a new livery to the topsides of the hull and repainted the bridge deck exterior areas. The main deck outside ceilings were also renewed before Tatasu was relaunched on schedule for the summer season.

Her full beam superstructure maximizes the interior spaces with natural light provided through the large (bullet proof) windows designed to blend in nicely in the yacht’s profile.

The yacht is like a luxurious private residence, with a unique full owners deck which includes a an lounge/office that can turn into a 6th stateroom and a large bathroom. The stern offers a unique watersports center that can hold the tender, has a dive store and is a spacious area for all kind of activities.

NEVER ENOUGH represents an incredible opportunity to own one of the most iconic Feadships to ever cruise the South Florida waters. Originally commissioned as GALLANT LADY and built for a repeat Feadship owner who had knowledge and expectations that were met in this build. An interior refit of all soft goods was finished in December 2022.

", "PageBreakBefore": false}, {"ExtID": "12028660", "Deleted": false, "VesselID": 293298, "CultureID": 1, "SectionID": 12113465, "SortOrder": 2, "SectionName": "Walkthrough", "SectionText": "

Boarding the boat via steps on the starboard side forward leads to the formal foyer entrance of the main salon. The popular path to enter the vessel is through the boarding gates on either side of the large covered aft deck. Casual seating on the aft deck is perfect for gathering to watch all the water sports that will be staged on the large swim platform if stern to a floating dock or if one is reaching the boat by tender. You can also enter the aft deck from the swim platform by taking a step from port or starboard.

 

Entering the main saloon from the aft deck through the custom-built double glass sliding doors, you will find an elegant and stylish lounge for entertaining guests. The entertaining bar to port is equipped with all the bar amenities one could need. The seating area includes large custom sofas, multiple chairs, high/low coffee tables, as well as a game table.

 

The main saloon has a spacious and open feel to it with great visibility through large windows port and starboard. The spacious formal dining area is one of three places to dine aboard. It features a custom rectangular dining table capable of seating ten guests, with plenty of natural light through the large side windows. There is ample storage to port for storing china, crystal and stemware. An automatic door to port acts as a service entrance between the galley and dining salon.

 

The large professional galley is located forward to port of the dining salon with access from the midship port side deck for ease of crew access and stocking galley supplies. As you enter the butler's pantry from the dining area, you will find an ice machine and dishwasher. All appliances in the galley are stainless steel units including 2 large side-by-side True refrigerators, steamer oven, dishwashers, 2-drawer freezer, cooktop and 2 double wall ovens and a microwave.

 

Going forward to starboard on the main deck is the on-deck powder room. Once entering the on-deck Owner's Suite, you will find a settee to starboard, king size berth with bedside table, and built-in desk to port forward. There is ample storage and closet space. The large ensuite is his and hers with shower and tub. The master includes a 50” TV.

 

Descending the starboard main foyer stairwell to the lower foyer, there is access to four large guest staterooms. Two mirror-image staterooms feature queen size beds, ensuite both have shower/tub combo and ample storage and hanging space in the closet. There are also mirror twin cabins with two twin berths in both cabins and ensuites with shower/tub combo.

 

Moving up the winding stairs from the guest foyer up two levels, passing the main deck to the bridge deck lies the bridge deck dining room. Moving aft you pass a well-appointed bridge deck powder room, continuing aft you enter the expansive skylounge with a very large dining table. Continue walking aft through a set of glass double doors leads to the third dining area on the spacious upper aft deck, featuring a custom teak table accommodating ten guests. Forward on this deck is the spacious pilothouse, with a leather settee with table for guests to enjoy the view without disturbing the captain. A large captain's office with navigation work desk, chart table and drawers is aft and to starboard. Three captain's chairs and plenty of storage are included in the bridge. The bridge wings feature docking stations port & starboard. Via Portuguese bridge access over a central catwalk in the deckhouse leads to the working foredeck which houses two Wave Runners.

 

Access to the Sundeck from the bridge deck aft is up a set of stairs centerline. The spacious deck includes a large jacuzzi, full bar set up, ample lounge areas and a full helm station.  On the aft part of the sundeck are several comfortable lounge chairs.

An interior refit of all soft goods was finished in December 2022.

", "PageBreakBefore": false}, {"ExtID": "12028660", "Deleted": false, "VesselID": 293298, "CultureID": 1, "SectionID": 12113465, "SortOrder": 2, "SectionName": "Walkthrough", "SectionText": "

Boarding the boat via steps on the starboard side forward leads to the formal foyer entrance of the main salon. The popular path to enter the vessel is through the boarding gates on either side of the large covered aft deck. Casual seating on the aft deck is perfect for gathering to watch all the water sports that will be staged on the large swim platform if stern to a floating dock or if one is reaching the boat by tender. You can also enter the aft deck from the swim platform by taking a step from port or starboard.

 

Entering the main saloon from the aft deck through the custom-built double glass sliding doors, you will find an elegant and stylish lounge for entertaining guests. The entertaining bar to port is equipped with all the bar amenities one could need. The seating area includes large custom sofas, multiple chairs, high/low coffee tables, as well as a game table.

 

The main saloon has a spacious and open feel to it with great visibility through large windows port and starboard. The spacious formal dining area is one of three places to dine aboard. It features a custom rectangular dining table capable of seating ten guests, with plenty of natural light through the large side windows. There is ample storage to port for storing china, crystal and stemware. An automatic door to port acts as a service entrance between the galley and dining salon.

 

The large professional galley is located forward to port of the dining salon with access from the midship port side deck for ease of crew access and stocking galley supplies. As you enter the butler's pantry from the dining area, you will find an ice machine and dishwasher. All appliances in the galley are stainless steel units including 2 large side-by-side True refrigerators, steamer oven, dishwashers, 2-drawer freezer, cooktop and 2 double wall ovens and a microwave.

 

Going forward to starboard on the main deck is the on-deck powder room. Once entering the on-deck Owner's Suite, you will find a settee to starboard, king size berth with bedside table, and built-in desk to port forward. There is ample storage and closet space. The large ensuite is his and hers with shower and tub. The master includes a 50” TV.

 

Descending the starboard main foyer stairwell to the lower foyer, there is access to four large guest staterooms. Two mirror-image staterooms feature queen size beds, ensuite both have shower/tub combo and ample storage and hanging space in the closet. There are also mirror twin cabins with two twin berths in both cabins and ensuites with shower/tub combo.

 

Moving up the winding stairs from the guest foyer up two levels, passing the main deck to the bridge deck lies the bridge deck dining room. Moving aft you pass a well-appointed bridge deck powder room, continuing aft you enter the expansive skylounge with a very large dining table. Continue walking aft through a set of glass double doors leads to the third dining area on the spacious upper aft deck, featuring a custom teak table accommodating ten guests. Forward on this deck is the spacious pilothouse, with a leather settee with table for guests to enjoy the view without disturbing the captain. A large captain's office with navigation work desk, chart table and drawers is aft and to starboard. Three captain's chairs and plenty of storage are included in the bridge. The bridge wings feature docking stations port & starboard. Via Portuguese bridge access over a central catwalk in the deckhouse leads to the working foredeck which houses two Wave Runners.

 

Access to the Sundeck from the bridge deck aft is up a set of stairs centerline. The spacious deck includes a large jacuzzi, full bar set up, ample lounge areas and a full helm station.  On the aft part of the sundeck are several comfortable lounge chairs.

", "PageBreakBefore": false}, {"ExtID": "12028660", "Deleted": false, "VesselID": 293298, "CultureID": 1, "SectionID": 12113465, "SortOrder": 2, "SectionName": "Walkthrough", "SectionText": "

Boarding the boat via steps on the starboard side forward leads to the formal foyer entrance of the main salon. The popular path to enter the vessel is through the boarding gates on either side of the large covered aft deck. Casual seating on the aft deck is perfect for gathering to watch all the water sports that will be staged on the large swim platform if stern to a floating dock or if one is reaching the boat by tender. You can also enter the aft deck from the swim platform by taking a step from port or starboard.

 

Entering the main saloon from the aft deck through the custom-built double glass sliding doors, you will find an elegant and stylish lounge for entertaining guests. The entertaining bar to port is equipped with all the bar amenities one could need. The seating area includes large custom sofas, multiple chairs, high/low coffee tables, as well as a game table.

 

The main saloon has a spacious and open feel to it with great visibility through large windows port and starboard. The spacious formal dining area is one of three places to dine aboard. It features a custom rectangular dining table capable of seating ten guests, with plenty of natural light through the large side windows. There is ample storage to port for storing china, crystal and stemware. An automatic door to port acts as a service entrance between the galley and dining salon.

 

The large professional galley is located forward to port of the dining salon with access from the midship port side deck for ease of crew access and stocking galley supplies. As you enter the butler's pantry from the dining area, you will find an ice machine and dishwasher. All appliances in the galley are stainless steel units including 2 large side-by-side True refrigerators, steamer oven, dishwashers, 2-drawer freezer, cooktop and 2 double wall ovens and a microwave.

 

Going forward to starboard on the main deck is the on-deck powder room. Once entering the on-deck Owner's Suite, you will find a settee to starboard, king size berth with bedside table, and built-in desk to port forward. There is ample storage and closet space. The large ensuite is his and hers with shower and tub. The master includes a 50” TV.

 

Descending the starboard main foyer stairwell to the lower foyer, there is access to four large guest staterooms. Two mirror-image staterooms feature queen size beds, ensuite both have shower/tub combo and ample storage and hanging space in the closet. There are also mirror twin cabins with two twin berths in both cabins and ensuites with shower/tub combo.

 

Moving up the winding stairs from the guest foyer up two levels, passing the main deck to the bridge deck lies the bridge deck dining room. Moving aft you pass a well-appointed bridge deck powder room, continuing aft you enter the expansive skylounge with a very large dining table. Continue walking aft through a set of glass double doors leads to the third dining area on the spacious upper aft deck, featuring a custom teak table accommodating ten guests. Forward on this deck is the spacious pilothouse, with a leather settee with table for guests to enjoy the view without disturbing the captain. A large captain's office with navigation work desk, chart table and drawers is aft and to starboard. Three captain's chairs and plenty of storage are included in the bridge. The bridge wings feature docking stations port & starboard. Via Portuguese bridge access over a central catwalk in the deckhouse leads to the working foredeck which houses two Wave Runners.

 

Access to the Sundeck from the bridge deck aft is up a set of stairs centerline. The spacious deck includes a large jacuzzi, full bar set up, ample lounge areas and a full helm station.  On the aft part of the sundeck are several comfortable lounge chairs.

", "PageBreakBefore": false}, {"ExtID": "12028660", "Deleted": false, "VesselID": 293298, "CultureID": 1, "SectionID": 12113465, "SortOrder": 2, "SectionName": "Walkthrough", "SectionText": "

Boarding the boat via steps on the starboard side forward leads to the formal foyer entrance of the main salon. The popular path to enter the vessel is through the boarding gates on either side of the large covered aft deck. Casual seating on the aft deck is perfect for gathering to watch all the water sports that will be staged on the large swim platform if stern to a floating dock or if one is reaching the boat by tender. You can also enter the aft deck from the swim platform by taking a step from port or starboard.

 

Entering the main saloon from the aft deck through the custom-built double glass sliding doors, you will find an elegant and stylish lounge for entertaining guests. The entertaining bar to port is equipped with all the bar amenities one could need. The seating area includes large custom sofas, multiple chairs, high/low coffee tables, as well as a game table.

 

The main saloon has a spacious and open feel to it with great visibility through large windows port and starboard. The spacious formal dining area is one of three places to dine aboard. It features a custom rectangular dining table capable of seating ten guests, with plenty of natural light through the large side windows. There is ample storage to port for storing china, crystal and stemware. An automatic door to port acts as a service entrance between the galley and dining salon.

 

The large professional galley is located forward to port of the dining salon with access from the midship port side deck for ease of crew access and stocking galley supplies. As you enter the butler's pantry from the dining area, you will find an ice machine and dishwasher. All appliances in the galley are stainless steel units including 2 large side-by-side True refrigerators, steamer oven, dishwashers, 2-drawer freezer, cooktop and 2 double wall ovens and a microwave.

 

Going forward to starboard on the main deck is the on-deck powder room. Once entering the on-deck Owner's Suite, you will find a settee to starboard, king size berth with bedside table, and built-in desk to port forward. There is ample storage and closet space. The large ensuite is his and hers with shower and tub. The master includes a 50” TV.

 

Descending the starboard main foyer stairwell to the lower foyer, there is access to four large guest staterooms. Two mirror-image staterooms feature queen size beds, ensuite both have shower/tub combo and ample storage and hanging space in the closet. There are also mirror twin cabins with two twin berths in both cabins and ensuites with shower/tub combo.

 

Moving up the winding stairs from the guest foyer up two levels, passing the main deck to the bridge deck lies the bridge deck dining room. Moving aft you pass a well-appointed bridge deck powder room, continuing aft you enter the expansive skylounge with a very large dining table. Continue walking aft through a set of glass double doors leads to the third dining area on the spacious upper aft deck, featuring a custom teak table accommodating ten guests. Forward on this deck is the spacious pilothouse, with a leather settee with table for guests to enjoy the view without disturbing the captain. A large captain's office with navigation work desk, chart table and drawers is aft and to starboard. Three captain's chairs and plenty of storage are included in the bridge. The bridge wings feature docking stations port & starboard. Via Portuguese bridge access over a central catwalk in the deckhouse leads to the working foredeck which houses two Wave Runners.

 

Access to the Sundeck from the bridge deck aft is up a set of stairs centerline. The spacious deck includes a large jacuzzi, full bar set up, ample lounge areas and a full helm station.  On the aft part of the sundeck are several comfortable lounge chairs.

EMERALD has been rebuilt to suit her European owners and their ambition to have a luxury home at sea. From the outset of the project they had clear-cut ideas of how EMERALD could be enhanced, all of which were made a reality with the help of Balk Shipyard in the Netherlands.

After arriving at Balk Shipyard in October 2021 measuring 48.6 metres in length following a previous extension, EMERALD was extended further bringing her to a total LOA of 50.4 metres.
Together with British studio Design Unlimited, EMERALD’s owners redesigned the entire interior and opted for a modern and timeless theme. The refreshed main-deck layout features a forward-facing master and neighbouring VIP suite, while the four remaining guest suites are situated on the lower deck. The main saloon is now an open-plan design with a small partition separating the lounge and dining area. The connecting main-deck galley has benefited also from a reconfiguration and complete upgrade to commercial equipment.

The bridge deck saloon was also extended as was the bridge deck cockpit where a single new crane replaces the two original cranes to manoeuvre the yacht’s selection of toys in and out of the water. Once clear of equipment, this space can be used as an outdoor lounge and leisure area.

The rebuilt sundeck which was also extended, now features a large spa bath forward, cosy seating area, sun beds and wet bar to form the perfect space to enjoy the sun.

On the lower deck, the space taken by the original VIP cabin now allows for a class leading crew mess, laundry room, cold stores and an additional engineers cabin whilst all of the crew cabins have also been entirely refitted.

As part of the rebuild, the yacht’s mast and superstructure archway were both redesigned to suit the modernised superyacht and the new equipment fitted to it.

Much of the equipment onboard EMERALD has been replaced with brand-new navigation systems, AV/ IT communication systems and two zero-speed Quantum extendable stabilisation fins to name just some. While those items such as the engines and generators which were new in 2015 have been fully serviced up to date.
With a stunning new paint job in Orion Green for the hull and Aquila White for the superstructure, EMERALD is ready to go for years to come!
